name: Abrams
lines: Don't worry, I'm on the case.
If they're smart, they'll stay out of my way.
They don't know who they're dealing with.
Try and stop me. See what happens.
I can take whatever they throw at me.
No one's taking this book from me.
One day, I'm gonna die. But it ain't gonna be today.
It's gonna be a long day, isn't it?
You got my number. Call me anytime.
I gotta get this book someplace safe.
Might as well enjoy the break while it lasts.
They'll be coming for this book sooner or later.
I got better things to do than get shot at.
One, five, ten. I don't care how many there are! I'll stand up to them all.
I'm not afraid of the mob.
This book is dangerous. I can't let it fall into the wrong hands.
They're not gonna wanna get up close.
If they try to step to me, they're gonna regret it.
Some moron is gonna try to punch me and they're not gonna like what happens next.
No one stands toe-to-toe with me.
You'd think that people would know by now that fighting me is a mistake.
Those idiots wanna walk up to me and die, that's fine by me.
This book is gonna give 'em more than they bargained for.
Let's see what this book can do.
Just need to last a little longer!
This book better save my ass!
If they don't get out of the way, that's on them.
I'm not afraid to charge into a fight.
I don't run from a fight.
It's not smart to get in my way.
The only way to face a problem is head-on.
I'm almost feeling like myself again.
If they wanna kill me, they're gonna have to work for it.
I'll fight to the bitter end.
They don't make 'em like me.
I didn't survive this long just to die here.
In the end, I will be the one still standing.
I know how to take a hit.
I can jump into the fight!
This book's gonna give 'em hell.
Lemme know when you're ready.
Ready to throw the book at 'em.
Ready to slam this book down!
I'll make that damned book work for me.
I know how to make an entrance.
Oh, I'll be ready when this thing tries to fly away.
Listen here, book. You work for me.
I gotta figure out how to use this damn book before it gets me killed!
They won't see this coming.
This should keep 'em on their toes.
This thing's gonna get me killed...
You're not ready to fight someone like me.
Looks like it's my day after all.
All the money in the world can't buy talent.
You thought you were gonna keep me down?
Thanks for having my back.
Don't come begging for mercy.
You guys getting the message yet?
You aren't worthy to fight me.
Keep throwing your lives away! It's fine by me.
Time to punch the hell out of people!
I'll cripple their abilities.
Ugh, that book's rubbing off on me!
Ready to improve my abilities.
I need to go back and train.
Wonder what I can get at the shop.
I should check out that shop.
Got enough for the best gear!
I should spend the cash when I get the chance.
I can get some serious gear.
I got a whooole lot of souls to spend.
Can't let all these souls go to waste.
Who do you think you were punching?
You ain't gettin' that off.
I shouldn't leave that lying around.
Someone should pick that up.
I'm not leaving this lying around.
I'm not saying no to free money!
A little extra scratch never hurts!
Job's done, that's all that matters.
They couldn't have gotten far.
You learn your lesson yet?
Pushed it a little too close.
Gonna go heal. Then, I'll be back in the fight.
An ambush could be coming from anywhere.
I may be tough, but I don't wanna take on the whole team alone!
Looks like I'm the only one left.
I can hold on until the others are back up!
Not sure I want to take 'em all on.
Rejuv's in hand! Now's our chance!
They have the rejuvenator!
Good. Now we get to kill 'em twice.
They got the rejuvenator! We need to be smart.
Need to get back out there.
I can't let my team down.
The time to rest is over.
I need to go win this thing.
Can't let the team have all the fun.
You're on your own for now.
Well, that wrapped up nicely.
They were never gonna stop us.
They fought hard. They couldn't match us.
Maybe trusting people isn't so bad after all.
They'll need all the luck they can get.
They're not gonna stop us.
They should run now and save us all some time.
I'm ready for 'em, Bebop!
That was pretty rude, Bebop!
They're going to be salty about that.
Great black hole, professor!
I was worried there for a minute.
Damn, you're accurate with that thing.
Very impressive, Grey Talon!
Glad we have the old man on our side.
Cutting it a little close, Talon!
Talon's looking out for us!
Holliday's locked 'em down.
Fern made short work of that.
Thanks for the assist, Ivy.
Stick with me, Ivy. We'll be doin' this all day!
Thanks for keeping me in the fight!
They couldn't have seen that coming.
Lash just came out of nowhere!
Thanks for the set-up, McGinnis!
That wall is just mean, McGinnis!
Just like you planned, McGinnis!
Thanks for lookin' out, McGinnis.
I knew I could count on you, McGinnis.
Krill brought us some time.
That is one dangerous man...
They didn't even have a chance.
Good God, that was impressive.
Ah, I needed that, Viscous.
Thanks for grabbin' 'em, Wraith!
She closed the distance fast!
Took out the scrap golem.
Stick to fighting Lash, Bebop.
This isn't a game, Bebop.
That thing never had a chance!
Y'gotta be faster than that, Bebop!
That laser supposed to be impressive?
Don't let Bebop hook you!
He seemed like a decent guy. Almost feel bad...
If I'm gonna die, it ain't gonna be to someone with patches on their elbows.
Keep an eye on the professor!
Look out for a black hole!
Killed the old man! Shit, I killed an old man.
Any other day, I'd be fighting by your side, Grey Talon.
You never should have let me get this close to you, Talon.
What did I do to piss off the feds?
I never wanted the OSIC as an enemy.
You were never escaping me, Haze.
Cute trick, Haze. It wasn't enough.
Picked a bad time to visit New York.
If I wanna solve my case, I gotta end yours.
The sheriff's a slippery one!
I'll make it up to you later, Fern.
He won't be starting fires anytime soon.
Hope I didn't kill my bartender for nothing.
You never had what it takes, Infernus.
Couldn't let you pull that off, Fern!
I feel pretty guilty about that... Not guilty enough not to punch her again but, still, guilty.
You picked the wrong side, Ivy.
You never should have come for me, Ivy.
Of course she flies away...
Who wears a parka this time o' year?
You seem like a decent guy, Kelvin. But you had to be stopped.
What are you gonna do, ice skate me to death?
You weren't fast enough, Kelvin.
You were never getting away, Kelvin.
Oathkeeper won't be fed today.
I knew I couldn't trust you, Geist.
She's probably gonna want me to move out.
This... is gonna be awkward back at the apartment.
Be careful, Geist can swap!
Geist is going to try to steal your health!
Don't get too close to Geist!
So... She's killable after all.
We gotta make a move while she's still down!
He had to stop jumping around some time...
He thought ego was a substitute for talent.
That... felt more satisfying than it should.
Shouldn't've messed with me, Lash.
You're not the one in control here.
Takes more than some machines to stop me.
Should've stayed in the workshop, McGinnis.
How many of these things does McGinnis have?
Don't take this personal, Mirage.
The brave are the first to die.
I'll buy you guys a round at Jezebel's later.
See you at the game Sunday, Krill.
I'll make it up to those guys another time.
Someone kill this moleman!
You weren't a threat. Just a nuisance.
You're clever, lady. But not as clever as you think you are.
Your little trick didn' work!
Gotta try better than that, Paradox.
You really think your little party trick would make a difference?!
You're a good kid, Pocket. This ain't the life for you.
Take your case and get outta town, Pocket!
You can't stop me, Pocket.
I know who you are, Pocket. Trust me when I tell you, it's not worth it!
You can't escape justice, Seven.
I'm not afraid of you, Seven!
Your machinations end here, Seven.
Men like you deserve to rot in Lost Whisper.
Run from the storm cloud!
Now the Baxter Society is hunting me.
Takes more than a couple of knives to take me down.
How is he still standing?
You made me do this, Vindicta!
Your anger is justified. But your methods are not.
There’s other ways to get what you want, Vindicta.
Take cover from Vindicta!
You think you had range on me?
Shoulda kept more distance, kid.
New York ain't the place for you, Viscous.
I dealt with the pile of goo.
There's a fine line between devotion and obsession, Warden.
I had to stop you, Warden!
You really need a new hobby, Warden.
That cape... kinda freaks me out.
Don't let Warden get near you!
You really thought some cards were going to stop me?
Hope she's still taking action on the Knickerbockers.
This better not kick me out of Sunday's card game...
What the hell is happening?
I'll put a stop to the Seventh Moon.
Yamato, you were never going to stop me!
You'll get this book over my dead body, Yamato.
I'm sorry about your brother, but this book can't help you.
She won't be easy to kill.

name: Apollo
lines: Mark my words: I will represent Ixia in the Olympics. It's only a matter of time.
My ambitions are far higher than Blackmore Academy.
I will honor my family's name.
The Patrons are lucky to have someone like me fight for them.
I'm ready to test myself.
I see you have excellent taste!
Like my father before me, I am a picture of grace and humility.
It is an honor to lead us to victory.
My father entrusted me with this blade, and I will honor him.
The family heirloom isn't a decorative piece. I know how to use it.
Sorry! Can't skip fencing practice.
You have no idea how busy I am.
I have to plan for my trip to Ixia this summer, anyway.
I can't be an Olympian if I'm dead.
I'm not stepping into a fight I'm not prepared for.
Apologies. Father requested my presence.
Thank you, but I prefer activities where I don't need to rely on others.
I'm afraid I won't be able to join you for the ritual.
I don't need the Patron to validate my greatness.
The sigil of my family will protect me.
A true son of Ixia knows how to defend themselves.
I can't let them trap me in a corner.
I have a few tricks up my sleeve.
I have fond memories of father teaching me this...
I won't let them pin me down.
I get to define the engagement. Not them.
I can't wait to see the look on their faces!
If they want to stop me, they're going to have to work for it.
If only this was legal in fencing tournaments!
My lineage will protect me!
I'm just getting started!
I got you where I want you!
Deflecting their blows will be trivial.
They won't lay a filthy hand on me.
Their frustration is only going to rise.
I'll shake their confidence before I run them through.
Father always said: the first step to victory begins with crushing the enemy's hope.
They will try their best, and it won't be enough.
They will learn what it means to fail.
Hard to stop an opponent you can't hit.
This was drilled into me since I was five.
Stopping their attacks is second nature to me.
That's the best you got?!
How embarrassing for you.
You really need to try harder.
What did you think was going to happen?
You actually thought that would work?
I really expected more from you.
I almost feel sorry for them.
Takes a lot more than that!
You think I'm giving up?!
Only one of us is dying today!
I know how to finish off an opponent.
I'll bleed them out, one strike at a time.
I'll strike when they least expect it.
My blade will dance amongst them.
I can strike them from any angle.
I'll use my speed to my advantage.
I need to rely on my cunning, as well as my strength.
I'm going to humble them.
En garde! (French: On guard!)
I can still finish them off!
Can't let 'em catch me...
Gotta finish 'em off fast!
Ready to charge through them!
Ready to charge into battle.
Say the word and I'll impale them.
Ready to strike through them.
Ready to show them what I can do.
I'll show them what my tutors taught me.
My training won't fail me!
I will bring glory to my family's name.
I'll be sure to finish them off.
My victory will not be denied.
I'm not going to hold anything back.
I hope they made peace with their god.
The results will speak for themselves.
I have no time for second guessing or self-doubt... I need to strike true and decisively.
I have to make this count.
I'm done toying with you!
And they thought they could stop me.
They fought; they failed.
I can't afford to get cocky. The ritual is far from over.
That was their best? How sad.
I'm beginning to see how the rest of my day's going to go.
I won't rest until we win.
This is but one of many who will fall.
You picked the wrong fight.
There's a reason I'm a champion.
Look on the bright side: you lost to the best.
You were courageous... and stupid. Mostly stupid.
You have tools at your disposal, but you don't know how to use them.
You thought you were on top of the world, didn't you?
We have unfinished business.
We need to keep the momentum going.
They don't have a chance in hell.
The weak always fall to the strong.
I've been training my whole life for this... you don't have a chance.
You have no idea who you're up against.
There's no shame in losing to me.
Of course they're dying: they're fighting me.
Will none of you rise to the challenge?
Guys, you can't stop me! I'm a generational talent!
Greatness runs in the family.
Face it: you're outclassed, and outmatched.
Strike while they're weakened!
Your bullets can't hurt me.
Oh, I'm just getting warmed up.
They won't see me coming!
I'll block their abilities.
Go ahead: waste your magic.
Your powers mean nothing.
It's time to go training.
I can't forget to train my powers.
I need to upgrade my abilities.
I can get something at the store!
I should check out the Curiosity Shop.
I can afford something new.
I wonder what I can buy now?
Might be time to get something.
I can afford a quality relic!
I need to think about what to buy next.
What to buy, what to buy?..
There's nothing I can't buy.
No point in saving more souls.
I need to go shopping when I can.
You didn't honestly think that would work, right?
I saw that coming a mile away.
That's never going to happen.
I knew you were going to try that.
There's souls over there!
Someone should get those souls.
I shouldn't leave those souls for them to pick up!
If they were stupid enough to leave this lying around... so be it.
I know not to pass up an opportunity.
I'll take any edge I can get.
Who cares? We took the objective.
A few souls won't make the difference.
We did what we came here to do.
They can have the souls. We got what we came for.
We took down the objective. Good work.
Where the hell did they go?
Quit hiding! Come out and face me!
I was just getting started.
They knew they were outmatched.
Bet they can't wait to tell their friends how they ran away from a high school kid.
Perhaps I was... a little too confident.
I almost got caught... I need to be more careful.
That could've ended poorly.
Lucky to get away when I did.
I may have overextended myself...
I need to be careful... I'm all alone.
Maybe I should pull back?
I won't embarrass my family.
My team is counting on me... I will not falter.
There's too many of them!
I need to pull back to a more favorable position.
Now's our chance to push the advantage!
Good job getting the Rejuvenator.
They have the Rejuvenator!
Be careful. They have the Rejuv!
Damn it, they have the Rejuvenator!
Time to complete the ritual!
We need to end this once and for all!
We can't let them have all the glory.
We can't falter when we're so close to victory!
Don't waste your bullets!
Our victory, while expected, is satisfying nonetheless.
We had this battle won from the moment it began.
No need to thank me, victory is its own reward.
I never doubted this would be the outcome.
Today's glory will not be forgotten.
I see you voters have finally come to your senses.
You all are about to bear witness to greatness.
I've sized up our opponents... we shouldn't be worried.
If we work together, victory will be assured.
Well... time to see what the Patron has given me to work with.
Try not to die before you're useful?
Thank you for all your help.
We need to support Abrams!
Abrams will never give up!
Abrams has the heart of a warrior!
Thanks for grabbing them, Bebop.
I'm ready for them, Bebop.
The guardian will deal with them.
Grey Talon had our backs!
Thanks for looking out, Talon.
So that's what a Sandman can do...
Watching her work is like poetry.
Haze was looking out for me.
Thanks for grabbing them, Holliday!
The sheriff did her part.
Holliday brought them right to us!
You were born for this, Infernus!
You're living up to your potential, Infernus.
It's an honor to fight alongside my brother!
Appreciate the help, Ivy.
Your timing's impeccable, Kelvin.
Help Geist finish them off!
I get why he's a big deal.
Thanks for the assist, McGinnis!
Paradox put them right where we want them!
They walked into Paradox's trap!
Seven... that was inhuman!
Seven butchered them all.
I've never seen power like that before.
He didn't waste a single movement!
They took out Father Quinn!
So, this is what relaxing feels like?..
He didn't falter for a moment.
Warden fights like a man possessed!
I'll admit: that was impressive.
He forgot where he came from.
I hate to do that to a fellow Ixian.
Why aren't you standing with me, brother?!
I take no joy in cutting down one of my own.
He was a titan of a man… a shame he made bad life choices.
I stopped the scrap golem.
I'm too fast for you, Bebop.
I'm not some drunk pit fighter, Bebop! I'm a real talent.
I don't see why Lash had trouble stopping him.
What chance did a machine have against me?
Never stand still in a fight.
You really are making this easy for me, Bebop.
Oh, just stand there and die!
You belong in a trash heap, Billy.
It's easy to rage aginst the elite when you have nothing of substance to offer, Billy.
Billy… no one will miss you.
I couldn't shut him up fast enough!
Her reputation seems to be overblown.
You're not used to fighting someone with talent, are you, Calico?
Stay away from my family, Calico!
It was a mistake taking this contract, Calico.
No way she's a real unicorn...
Go back to working children's birthday parties!
The unicorn isn't a problem anymore.
Stopped the circus freak.
Well, I'll say this: the man had decorum.
I took care of the Doorman.
Your tricks are just a novelty, Doorman. They'll never be enough to win.
I don't care if he tried to kill me, the Baroness still has the best brunch in Manhattan.
I tipped the man last weekend, and he tries to kill me? No class!
You should have stuck with human prey, Drifter.
I'm not afraid of you, Drifter.
I'm not your victim, Drifter, I'm your executioner.
He thought he was in control, didn't he?
I took out the professor.
You deal in theoreticals, professor... but my dominance is reality.
I took down their support.
I'm sure he makes a better teacher than he does a fighter.
He was brave, albeit inept.
Look out for the professor!
Look out for the black hole!
It's a shame you stood against me, Graves.
Not all Blackmore students are created equal.
She was a decent lab partner.
I stopped the necromancer.
I'm sorry about your family.
I gave him the death he wanted.
You're a good man, Grey Talon. I'm sorry.
It's an honor to fight someone of your pedigree, Grey Talon.
I'm more dangerous than I thought.
That the best you got, Haze?
That should impress my father.
She'll be back, and I'll need to be ready.
You weren't escaping me, Haze.
That's what you get for running.
The sheriff was no threat.
She didn't live up to family name.
Her grandfather must be so disappointed in her.
Of course she bounces away...
The sheriff can't run forever!
She'll come back eventually... and then I'll finish what I started.
You can do better than that, Infernus.
Have some self-respect, Infernus! Stop being a human's hired help!
Your parents should have taught you about your culture.
Under proper tutelage you could have been somebody, Infernus.
You have so much power... and you waste it peddling drinks in a pool hall.
A brave attempt, but futile.
You're a noble woman, Ivy. I'm sure we'll meet again.
She fights with emotion… probably why she lost.
Who else wants to fall to my blade?
The Savior of Spanish Harlem herself couldn’t stop me.
I never thought the Savior of Spanish Harlem would be such a coward!
I'll be here all day, Ivy!
I've read stories about you, Kelvin... you fell a little short of the legend.
Not all adventures have a happy ending, Kelvin.
No one cheats death forever, Kelvin!
I put Kelvin in the ground.
And where did you think you were going, Kelvin?
At least you made me work for it, Kelvin.
I won't be one of your victims, Lady Geist!
Oathkeeper will die with you, Geist.
She got what was coming to her.
Geist can swap you, be careful!
Don't get too close to Geist!
You couldn't even beat a high school kid, Lash. How sad.
This has got to be humiliating for you, doesn't it?
Lash, you're not the best. I am.
I could take your stupid Bear Pit title from you any day I want.
Ego wilts in the face of real talent.
You're not on my level, Lash.
A pity you're not on my side, McGinnis. My father would be a fan.
A brilliant mind… a mediocre combatant.
You can't rely on technology to do the work for you, McGinnis.
Her inventions could not save her.
I'll take these out all day!
How many of these damn things does she have?!
You always had too high of an opinion of yourself, Mina.
You're not half as good as you think you are, Mina.
No love for your alma mater, Mina?
I hate self-important people...
My father sends his regards to Ambassador Nashala.
This isn't how I was hoping I would meet the ambassador. Apologies.
He seemed like a decent guy.
Perhaps you should have stayed underground where you belong.
Krill, you pretend to be a man of culture, but you're just a crook.
Brought down Mo and Krill.
You seem like a good person, Paige. I'm sorry.
I feel like I was fighting a primary school teacher.
Paige isn't a threat to us.
We don't need to worry about Paige.
I'm not losing to a glorified librarian.
Paradox's antics have come to an end.
She thought she was untouchable... she was wrong.
Paradox, you are all mystique. No talent.
You're nothing more than a vandal that fancies herself a revolutionary.
You never should've tried to duel me, Paradox!
That was never going to be enough, Paradox.
I don't respect anyone who runs from their obligations.
Your father's a great man, Pocket… it's a shame you fell so short.
You should have hid in that case for longer.
You could have had the world at your fingertips, Pocket, but you pissed it all away.
You can change your name, but you can't change who you are, Pocket.
Ugh, go back to the petting zoo! Or wherever you crawled out of...
I don't know what that thing was, but it's dead.
I know better than to be deceived by appearances.
It doesn't matter how cute it looked, it was a threat.
There are no shortcuts to power, Seven.
It was a privilage to stop someone like him.
I'm not scared of you, Seven.
I won't be intimidated by humans with delusions of grandeur!
I'm not running from you, Seven, I'm running through you!
I thought he would be more dangerous?
He knows how to use a knife, I'll give him that.
I would think the Baxter Society could afford better teachers.
Why isn't Shiv going down?!
How is he still standing?!
I just killed a werewolf. You're welcome.
My father would have turned her into a cloak.
She was dangerous, but undisciplined.
Silver was all emotion. No skill.
Parlor tricks were never going to be enough.
I won't suffer the indignity of being turned into a rabbit!
I'm not worried about someone whose claim to fame involves silk scarves.
I won't be hunted like some pathetic vampire.
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Father.
Nothing personal, Victor.
I put him out of his misery.
Don't try getting back up, Victor.
He was a tenacious enemy.
Only a coward kills a man at a distance.
You're not picking me off, Vindicta.
You underestimated me, Vindicta.
I'm not a dilettante that’s going to stand around to get shot, Vindicta.
You thought you were safe?!
It's true, I am impressive.
You can't hide from me, Vindicta!
The Deep's issues matter little to Ixia.
You don't belong here, Viscous.
You never had a chance against me, Viscous.
The Cube only delays the inevitable.
She was a blight on society.
You trained your whole life, Warden, and you still fail. How sad.
You were a worthy opponent, Warden.
The man had discipline and conviction… it's a shame he didn't fight for us.
You prey on people's vices, Wraith. I can't respect that.
You crave a legitamcy you will never earn, Wraith… because at the end of the day you're just a goon with a gun.
Better luck next time, Wraith!
Yamato was a middling talent.
Not all swordsmen are created equal.
And here I was thinking Yamato would be a challenge.
I've had better sparring partners.
Keep your distance from Yamato!

name: Bebop
lines: My creator needs my help, and I won't let her down.
I'll do whatever it takes to save Miss Shelly.
Miss Shelly is taking her nap. I probably got enough time to contact some godlike creature!
People get me all wrong. I'm not interested in violence for violence's sake! I'm interested in violence for money's sake.
A little trouble never hurt anyone!
The only way this day gets any better is if I get to punch Lash in the face.
Ready to start some trouble with me, mates?
Facing me's the last mistake they're gonna make.
'Fraid I gotta get back to the junkyard.
Good. More time for me to work out new ways to hurt Lash.
Can't. Miss Shelly needs my help.
Just promise me you won't work with Lash?
Not a choice I'd make, but hey, it's your life.
Miss Shelly's having one of her good days so, I'm gonna spend time with her while I can.
Timing's pretty bad, mate.
There's work to be done at the junkyard.
You'll be fine without me. Miss Shelly, though? She needs me.
I'll give 'em a proper send-off.
I'll knock 'em out of the fight!
I'm gonna send them flying!
You ever punch a man a city block? Hell of a feeling.
I can't wait to throw hands.
The ol' left hand won me a lot of purses. I'm in.
Sometimes you need a laser. Sometimes you just need your fist.
No one hits harder than me.
There ain't a man alive I can't send flying.
Oh, sorry mate! Yeah... Cheers!
Why don't you play with our Guardian?
Have fun playin' with our Walker!
You want the Patron? Here ya go!
Oh, I love using these...
Sometimes, when I put these on people, they're like: "Oh no! What can I do?" And it's like: Nothing, mate! You're gonna blow up!
Is sticking someone with a bomb they can't remove fair? Of course not. If it was, I wouldn't be doin' it.
The only thing that makes this better is sending them flying before the bomb goes off.
Another thing humans are bad at: Surviving explosions.
I love the looks on their faces.
The inevitable is a hell of a thing.
I just love giving these to people!
I got enough of these for everyone!

name: Celeste
lines: I like workin' the sideshow. They're, uh... they're my people, y'know?

Coney is safe... comfortable... but I've outgrown it... and fear can't be the only thing keeping me there.
If you need my help, I'll be there.
I've lived in the shadows my whole life, and I'm tired of it.
I'm not a one-trick pony!.. I got like four. Five if you count the one where I get an injured audience member not to sue!
Look, I got three matinees, five evening shows, and a private performance for a divorced dad that wants to buy his kids love.
Don't feel like I'm ready to face the world today, you know?
I've been doing a lot of thinking, and I got a good thing going on Coney. Why risk it?
I don't think it's exactly safe to be outside.
I think I'll stay with the rest of the carnies.
I don't want to hurt anyone.
I'm afraid of what'll happen if I go out there...
Light Eater's almost ready!
Light Eater's on cooldown!
This'll singe some eyebrows.
I had to move the front row back a little after one too many incidents with this.
Thing's are gonna get a little spicy.
This is so much better than boring fire!
When in doubt: breathe a little fire.
I feel bad for the normies who can't breathe fire.
I haven't had to call the fire department in a while, so I think I'm getting the hang of it!
This used to be my closer at the kids' birthday parties, until Julia McClomsky and her lawsuits came along.
I know how to protect myself!
Gonna get a little toasty.
You're makin' me do this.

If I wanna win... I have to be willing to cut loose.

My light will still shine!
Lemme show you who I really am.

I'll do as much damage as I can.

Ugh, that guy was so uptight!
I still love you guys. Sorry.

I'm gonna feel terrible about that later.
You picked the wrong day to come out of the sewer, Mo.
God, she was so adorable...
That poor girl is in over her head.
I just want to give her a hug... I mean, not now, obviously, but in general.

Knocked Vindicta outta the sky!
She overstayed her welcome.
I can make it up to him later.
Viscous is nice, he'll forgive me.
Stopped that ball of goo!
Shoulda went into the Cube.
Didn't work too well for ya Viscous, did it?

Quit stalkin' people, Vyper!

Glad I'm walkin' away from that in one piece.
When he comes back, he's gonna want revenge.
Warden isn't gonna forget what I just did to him...
Don't get close to Warden!
Tell you what, Wraith: forget the marker on Dutch, and I'll stop kickin' your ass!
I'm not scared of you, Wraith!
You're not gonna shake me down, Wraith!

Yamato's gonna be lookin' for payback.
Pissin' off the Seventh Moon probably wasn't my best choice.
Well, she wasn't very nice...
Watch where you swing that thing, Yamato! You might hurt someone.

They will find fighting us more difficult than they expect.

I'll influence the fight with a subtle hand.

You’ve overstayed your welcome.
I’ll deal with the hooligan.
I must be clever when placing these.
I will warp reality to my whim.
Time to break some minds.
To those with real power, the rules of reality are mere suggestions!
I will build a path for my allies.
Such wonders I will show them.
To the clever mind, this will assure victory.
I will go where I desire.
I will bridge a gap between reality.
We will stride across time and space.

Allow me to be of assistance.

Time to get a little creative.
Luggage Cart's almost ready.
Luggage Cart's on cooldown.
The weak are easily dispersed.
They won't get close to me.
I'll have the luggage cart ready.
I'll dismiss them with a wave of my hand.
Our enemies will be sent flying!
I'll launch them across the battlefield.
I have a way of dealing with unwanted guests.
The uncouth will be dismissed.
I believe my assistance is needed.
A trivial display of power.
Ah-ah, move along, please.
The Baroness is ready to receive new guests.
Ready to banish our enemies!
Ready to tear their minds asunder.
Ready to take them to the Baroness.
Ready to pull them off the battlefield.
I will usher them to realms unimaginable.
Ready to show them what real power looks like!
Ready to warp time and space.
The Baroness is almost ready.
Hotel Guest's on cooldown.
No one resists the call of the Baroness.
I look forward to checking in new guests.
The Baroness has rooms for everyone.
The Baroness will receive our foes with open arms.
I can't wait to see the comment cards our guests will fill!
I'll make sure the rooms are prepared.
They will never forget their stay at the Baroness.
The august halls of the Baroness await them.
They will die surrounded by the finest of luxury.
The Patrons won't mind if I put my thumb on the scale a little.
I’ll take you to your room.
The Baroness opens its arms for you.
Let me show you upstairs.
Your stay will be unforgettable.
I hope you enjoy your stay here.
Please, enjoy our Hospitality.
Such secrets The Baroness can show you.
All you have to do is walk toward that door.
The Baroness is always looking for new guests.
I hope your time at The Baroness is Unforgettable.
Please, forgive the mess, The Baroness is mid-renovation.
You are, of course, welcome to stay at The Baroness for as long as you'd like. I do hope you enjoy your visit.
Right now, I'm sure your mind is reeling. Questioning your very eyes, if not your sanity.
The hallowed halls of The Baroness welcome all. We do not discriminate. Stay as long as you’d like.
Thank you for giving your life at The Baroness Hotel. Gratuities are never expected, but always appreciated.
The Tome will pull you down with it, Abrams. It is inevitable.
The Tome is an impossible burden, detective. Why don’t you lay your head down and enjoy the amenities that The Baroness can offer?
Know this, Bebop: when Ms. Shelly dies, it will be because of your failure.
Billy, you are impressively uninteresting.
Look on the bright side, Calico. When your body rots, I’ll take care of your cat.
Now this is certainly unexpected.
Professor, be honest with yourself: you’re never getting your body back.
Talon, you couldn’t save your family and you can’t save yourself.
Keep calling yourself a Sandman instead of executioner. Maybe you’ll believe it.
You failed to stop the Troubadour in Macomb, and you’ll fail again in New York.
I can only imagine the horrors you witnessed in Macomb. Rest, Holliday, and put aside your trauma for tomorrow.
You thought you put your past behind you, but it will be your undoing.
You ruined many lives, Infernus. Do you really think that saving Hank’s bar will make up for the harm you caused?
If you’re here with me, who is protecting the Arroyos from Mendoza?
You pushed away Ettrick for his ambitions, yet remained a slave to your own.
That ward on your arm won’t hold forever, Geist. Oathkeeper is coming for you.
Lady Geist, I have the most wonderful room for two. I’m sure that you and Oathkeeper will be happy at The Baroness.
Oh look, a stevedore with delusions of grandeur.
Lash, Lash, Lash. You have been such a naughty boy lately. Whatever should I do with you?
Your creations are responsible for the deaths of millions, McGinnis. You’re a monster.
You’re a nobody, Mina. You don’t have a chance at becoming viscount.
Wyoming is a pipe dream, Mirage. The Djinn are doomed.
Wyoming can wait, Mirage. If your goal is to protect Nashala, there is no safer place in the world than The Baroness.
Maurice, Krill is just dead weight. Kill him.
Krill, Maurice would be better off if he never met you.
You’re not the hero of your story. You’re a footnote in mine.
What will the Paradox council think when you fail in truly spectacular fashion?
Why couldn’t you have just died, like your family wanted? It would have saved us a lot of trouble.
Seven, your ambition got you killed once, why haven’t you learned your lesson?
I’d offer you advice, but I know you wouldn’t take it. Good luck on your pursuit, Seven. I hope, in the end, the price that you paid was worth it.
The Baxter Society will turn on you, Shiv. It’s only a matter of time.
You don’t belong in the Baxter Society, Shiv, you know this. But there will always be a place for you here at The Baroness.
You will be bound to each other for eternity.
I know you're prepared to die here, Venator, which is good, because you shall.
You know, Cain, one day you will actually believe the legend you sell to people, and on that day you will die screaming.
You weren’t made for great purpose, you were made on a whim, to satisfy some scientist’s hubris.
You can’t put a bullet through hate, Vindicta. Hathorne will win.
Humans don’t understand the problems of the Deep because they don’t care about the problems of the Deep.
I suppose The Baroness is much like the Cube. A warm refuge where you get to feel the glorious embrace of oblivion.
Oh, why bother taunting you, you’re going to die of liver failure anyway.
You’re not a man, you’re a war doll, fixing mommy and daddy’s failures.
What do you want, Warden? I can’t restore the childhood you were denied, but you can be happy here. All you have to do is choose to stay.
Your aspirations are about to come crashing down, Wraith. The house always wins.
The only way you’ll ever honor your brother is by falling on his sword.
Another brute dispatched.
It would appear I made a mess.
Little children playing at war pose no threat to me.
They have no idea the deep waters they now find themselves in.
The fool thought they could stop me.
I hope there's not blood on my uniform.
Look what you made me do.
I can't remember the last time I had to kill someone with my own hands.
Your wealth does not impress.
I haven't forgot what you did.
You make for a lovely companion.
We complement each other nicely, don't we?
Old habits die hard, I'm afraid.
I've come this far, I might as well kill them all, I suppose.
So, it's to be a day of violence, I see.
Dispensing gratuitous violence is so much easier than I remembered!
In time, I will butcher you all!
I forgot how wonderful it can feel to be feared.
If you give up now, I'll throw in a free night stay at the Baroness.
You're running out of time to not be slaughtered like the lambs you are, just surrender!
I haven't slaughtered man like this for years, what a treat!
Mortals, your pointless lives are about to come to an end!
Don't you fools get it? I am the Patron you should worry about angering!
I'll crush them like the ants they are!
Now's the time to make them suffer!
My power is without limit!
What can bullets do to a god?!
The Baroness will call to them.
Ready to see another guest.
The Baroness calls from across the cosmos!
The magic of man will crumble.
Your magic will never harm me!
Let their suffering fuel me!
I will heal, and they will die.
I mustn't forget to upgrade my powers.
Soon, my powers will grow.
Time to pick up a trinket.
I should go by the Curiosity Shop.
I might want to buy an item.
I wonder what I can afford now.
I can afford something new at the shop.
It might be time to spend souls.
I should consider my next purchase carefully.
I have enough souls to buy something of real value.
I should see what the Shopkeeper has for me now.
There's nothing I can't afford!
I do believe that it's time to go shopping.
I can afford whatever the Shopkeeper passes off as luxury.
There'll be none of that.
I should get those souls.
I shouldn't leave the souls lying around.
No sense in letting this go to waste.
I'm sure I'll find a way to spend this.
The objective is still destroyed, that's what matters.
The ritual is closer to completion!
Another part of the ritual complete.
I look forward to saying "hello" to some old friends.
Now, where did they run off to?
Oh, don't run and hide, we were having so much fun together!
There'll be more opportunities to kill them.
Look at them scurry away.
I look forward to meeting them again.
Come back when you find your courage, friend.
They're scrappier than I anticipated.
They thought they could actually stop me.
Well, at least they tried.
I won't be killed by the likes of them.
Hmm... The enemy can be anywhere.
I bet they're hiding in walls like the vermin they are.
Perhaps I'm too far from my allies.
I will tend to things until my allies return.
There's too many of them!
I don't care for these odds!
The math is not in my favour.
It's time to get back to work.
We need to prepare our defences.
They have the Rejuvenator! We need to be careful.
They're going to try to take objectives, and we need to be ready!
It's time to complete the ritual.
The Patron will be summoned!
And now we crush them like ants!
This is the beginning of the end.
Don't bother shooting them!
I must return to the Baroness.
Should you have further need of my services, you know where to find me.
You know, you don't have to complete the ritual. You could come to the Baroness for a spa day!
The sooner we complete the ritual, the sooner I can return to my duties at the Baroness.
How exciting to see City Mother and the Amber King once more!
There is a lovely brunch going on at the Baroness as we speak.
I, for one, am liking our chances!
I am excited to help you mortals enrich your meaningless lives!
It was an honor to complete the ritual with you all.
Meddling in the Patrons' affairs is always satisfying.
There goes a man of conviction.
They'll never stop Abrams!
The Ixian fights with fervor!
Don't stop fighting, Abrams!
There goes one useful idiot.
I am in your debt, Dynamo.
That man is consumed by vengeance!
They can't hide from you, Talon.
Grey Talon was looking out for us.
That man's timing is impeccable.
I could watch her dance for hours.
She is a master at her craft.
Be careful out there, Infernus.
Good to see you cut loose, Infernus.
Thanks for your help, Infernus.
Well, that didn't last long.
I hope she doesn't find herself in too much trouble.
Thanks for your help, Ivy.
Ivy, you make for a lovely companion.
You have a gift for demolition, Ivy.
Your aid will not be forgotten.
Help Geist finish them off!
I hope he's as good as he says he is.
So that's the brightest mind humanity has to offer...
They could never escape you, McGinnis.
Thanks for the help, McGinnis!
Your service is appreciated, McGinnis.
The Djinn are counting on you, Mirage.
Pardon me, Miss Patience.
Have fun out there, Paradox.
Help Paradox finish them off!
Don't stop 'til they're dead, Shiv.
Hope they can work out their differences...
Good luck out there, Cain!
She took their head clean off.
Vindicta, you are something else!
There goes the happiest goo that has ever lived.
It's like the spa at the Baroness.
The Baroness needs to install a Cube.
That man's resolve is impressive.
Follow Warden to victory.
That woman has wicked intent.
You are relentless, my dear.
My, my, Yamato, you are full of surprises!
There's no escaping Yamato!
Detective Abrams has been put down.
You're out of your element, detective.
You can't punch your way through every problem, Abrams!
Help me kill the detective!
Good God, Abrams won't die!
The scrap golem's been handled.
Bebop is no longer a concern.
Go back to the scrapyard, Bebop.
Tend to Ms. Shelly, Bebop. It's safer for you.
Your flesh may be iron, but your heart is too soft for this.
Brute force will only get you so far, Bebop.
You poor, predictable automaton.
I thought you'd make me work for it, Bebop.
Billy, you make for a perfectly mediocre sacrifice.
Well, now you have something else to complain about, Billy.
Ava is welcome to stay at the Baroness as long as she wishes.
Ava will belong to the Baroness soon enough.
I can't have you assassinating my allies, Calico!
You took the wrong contract, Calico.
Always a pleasure to see you again, Drifter.
The Drifter stalks us no more.
This is New York, not some spooky Mardi Gras.
I won't be hunted by the likes of you!
New York is your hunting ground no longer.
Greetings and farewell, professor.
A man of culture met a noble end.
I took down the professor.
Professor Dynamo isn't a threat anymore.
You dabble in the void, professor, but it is not enough.
Look out for the black hole!
Your quest for vengeance has come to an end, Grey Talon!
He was too old to be a real threat.
I almost pity you, old man.
All hunts come to an end eventually.
The OSIC is not in control here.
You've never fought someone like me, Haze.
Haze, your handlers sent you here to die.
You can't run from me, Haze.
You think you can cloud my mind, Haze?
New York does not suit you, Holliday.
Go back to the cornfields where you were safe.
No wonder the Troubadour toyed with her, she's no threat!
Run while you can, Holliday!
And so, once again, the sheriff runs from her responsibilities!
I hate fighting a fellow member of the service industry.
Infernus will forgive me. He understands the way the world works.
I hate that our employers are pitting us against each other, Infernus.
It wasn't personal, Infernus, I hope you understand that.
Oh, that would never do, Infernus.
I can't have you blowing up my friends, Infernus.
You have a big heart, Ivy. That won't save you here.
Go home to the Arroyos while you can, Ivy.
I'm not some petty crook, Ivy, you never had a chance!
I took down the gargoyle.
And now she's flown away.
You can fly, Ivy, but I'll still find you!
Your ice path is adorable, but it's not bending space and time.
Kelvin never had a chance.
Stick to Rockefeller Center, Kelvin.
There's no escape, Kelvin!
Kelvin, you didn't think we were going to get away, did you?
Better luck next time, Lady Geist.
At the end of the day, a Queen Bee is still merely an insect.
Oathkeeper's power is nothing compared to my own.
Stay away from Lady Geist!
Lady Geist looks to steal our health!
Don't get too close to Geist.
You're too predictable, Lash!
That's the best you got, Lash?!
Look at him leaping to his demise!
I stopped their engineer.
I do enjoy your tools of war, McGinnis, but they aren't enough.
Quaint little machines will never be enough to stop me.
You never had a chance, McGinnis.
How many of these wretched machines does she have?
McGinnis, you are beginning to annoy me!
I can't believe she thinks that she can be Viscount!
Vampires and their delusions of grandeur...
The vampire girl's missing.
I'm sorry your stay at the Baroness was cut short.
I do hate killing the guests.
Please, give Ambassador Nashala my deepest apologies.
It's rather unfortunate that things turned out this way, Mirage.
The Djinn-bearer is dead.
You're strong, Maurice, but not strong enough.
Well, that was one angry mole...
I'm glad I survived that fight with both my arms intact.
Get this damn mole away from me!
Stick to the library, my dear.
Every story has an ending, Paige.
I took out their support.
I dealt with the bookworm.
Her taste in books was actually quite lovely.

The time thief won't be bothering us.
Tsk tsk tsk, Paradox, when are you going to learn?

You have to try harder than that, Paradox!
You're not half as clever as you think you are, Paradox!
You made a grave mistake, Paradox!
The child was out of their depth.
Pocket, you were doomed the moment you returned to New York.
Your father is going to be so disappointed, Pocket.
We don't need to worry about Pocket for a while.
You are miles away from the god you wish you were, Seven!
And people say Lash is delusional!
You're the best the Baxter Society can muster?!
Your knife-throwing days are over.
He wasn't a hunter, he was a sheep with a shotgun.
Your mission is doomed to fail, Venator!
Run back to your handlers while you still can!
You've never faced someone like me before, Cain.
I'm not some petty vampire that you can just stake!
You should have trained harder, Venator.
Return to obscurity, Victor, it's where you belong!
I stopped the cadaver man.
You can't hide from me, Vindicta.
Your ambition exceeded your talent, Vindicta.
You won't be picking off my friends.
I will always be able to get to you, Vindicta, you are far from untouchable.
Look out for their sniper!
She thought she was so clever.
She should have flown away.
Back to the Deep with you, Viscous.
I dealt with the petty criminal!
Vyper won't be bothering us for a while.
Your parents will be sorely disappointed in you.
A failure, just like your father.
Maybe one day you'll have a son, and he'll grow up to be a disappointment just like you.
Warden has been dealt with.
Don't let Warden get close!
Wraith, I just want you to know that I still think you're a delight!
She was such a generous tipper, too!
The Patrons will make enemies of us all, won't they?
You chose to back the wrong Patron, Wraith.
My friendships will certainly be tested today, won't they?
Yamato has been defeated.
Perhaps New York does not suit you, Yamato.
A wonder people didn't think you were fit to lead.
Your brother's sacrifice was in vain.

name: Drifter
lines: The Troubadour ain’t got nothin’ on me.
Oh, I’m exactly who you think I am.
By the time I’m through with them, the cops won’t be able to identify the body.
Fact of the matter is: I'd do this for free. The Patron's gift is just a bonus.

Can’t wait to see how Manhattan’s changed in one generation.
Let’s get this show on the road, I’m feelin’ peckish.
We all got weaknesses, but mercy ain’t one of mine.
They gonna cry, they gonna beg, they gonna scream.
I don't need the Patron's help.
I had my own plans tonight.
Do I look like I need to be the Patron's errand boy?
Wish I could help, but I have an old friend I need to say hello to.
I came to New York for a reason, and it wasn't to help the Patrons.
I don't work for anybody but myself.
Today, I plan to sit back and just watch the carnage unfold.
They're gonna tear each other apart for whatever scraps the Patrons give 'em... And it's gonna be beautiful to watch.
I don't need the Patrons, the Patrons need me.
Killin's no fun if someone's telling you to do it. You gotta just feel it in the moment, like jazz.
I can't wait to rip their lungs out.
I love workin' with my hands.
Ready to get up close and personal.
The best part of working close is you get to hear every beautiful sound.
My hands are twitchin' in anticipation.
I'm gonna tear them apart, and there ain't a damn thing they can do about it.
Lookin' forward to slicin' them open!
Ready to do what I do best.
Hohohoho, I'm ready to play!
You got some fight in ya!
Stalker's Mark is almost ready!
Stalker's Mark's on cooldown.
I'll be behind them in no time.
I'll get the element of surprise.
I'll get the jump on them.
They'll think they're safe, then I'll be right behind 'em.
I won't be deterred from my purpose.
I'll take whatever I want, whenever I want.
Once I set my eyes on someone, there's no shakin' me.
I can't wait to meet the lovely people of New York.
Let's see what your insides look like!
You don't think you're gonna win, do ya?
The Hunger's almost ready.
There's no one I can't track.
Let them try to run, it won't help.
I love it when they cower!
If I find someone on their own, God himself couldn't save 'em.
I'll find them, wherever they run to.
I love the thrill of the hunt.
Their blood will betray them.
The hunters be on the prowl tonight!
I won't stop until they're dead.
I'm comin' for you, Wesley.
Wesley? It's time we finish this.
Oathkeeper is calling to me, Geist.
Is the big, bad Sandman trying to hide from me?
Come on, sheriff! You didn't come all the way to New York just to hide from monsters.
Infernus, you didn't think you could try to burn me and I'd just let you go, did you?
Come out and face me, Ivy! Unless you want me to pay the Arroyos a visit.
Lash? Come out and die like a man.
How long you think you can hide from me, child?
Where you run off to, Pocket?
Seven, don't tell me you're scared? I expected so much more from you.
Why you hidin', Shiv? Don't want to say hello to an old friend?
Come out and play, Venator... Don't be scared.
Bet you haven't been scared in a long while, Vindicta.
Ready to make 'em afraid of the dark.
Ready to make 'em all blind.
Ready to make darkness fall.
Ready to spread darkness.
The darkness will spread.
They are not gonna see us comin'!
The Darkness is almost ready!
The Darkness is on cooldown.
They're gonna be lost in the wilderness.
The darkness will come for 'em.
First comes the darkness, then comes the terror.
They're gonna hear me whistle, then they're gonna die.
I bring the night with me.
They won't know where to turn.
The walls are gonna close in on 'em.
They're gonna feel alone and they're gonna feel scared, heheheh...
You gotta let the dread marinate a little.
No time to play with my food.
Death walks amongst them!
Their suffering's about to begin.
They can try to fight back, but it won't matter.
The darkness comes for you.
Love what you do, you'll never work a day in your life.
I could listen to that scream all day.
This is the best vacation I've ever took!
God, I love visiting New York.
Might be time to pull back.
Well, that was satisfying.
Not a bad way to spend the afternoon.
Friendly word of advice: you might wanna stay away from Times Square tonight. I plan on celebrating.
They'll never survive, heheheh...
Every single one of them are gonna die.
Take a look at 'em now! They won't be recognisable later.
I ain't liking their odds.
Now I just gotta pick on which one of these fine people I'm gonna carve up first.
Y'all came a long way to die, friends!
Any you fine folk wanna kill again, let me know.
I hope to see y'all again real soon.
They took out that pathetic excuse for a vampire!
He was a big boy, now wasn't he?
It's fun when they're strong like that.
Ho-ho, he put up a good fight!
There's that fightin' spirit, Abrams!
I like you, detective. You're fun to play with.
Machines are so dissatisfying to kill.
I heard about Ms. Shelly, Bebop, and I can't wait to meet her.
Bet the anger's gonna taint the meat.
Bein' a victim is different than playin' one, ain't it, Billy?
Does that guy ever stop complainin'?
I hate it when they whine...
Always nice when I get to kill Wesley's friends.
Huntin' man ain't the same as huntin' me.
Wesley could never stop me, and you're no Wesley.
Cute tricks aren't gonna be enough to stop me, Doorman.
Why don't you scurry back to the Baroness, Doorman?
The streets aren't your dominion, Doorman, they're mine.
Stay outta my business, Doorman.
Now what was his wife's name again?.. Marla, heheheh...
Don't worry, Dynamo, your wife will be joinin' you soon enough.
You gonna regret angerin' me, professor.
I took out their support.
Only way this was going to end, Wesley.
Been a long time comin', Grey Talon.
The fun had to end sometime, didn't it?
You had a good run, Talon.
I waited a long time to kill you, Wesley.
Ha, I enjoyed playing with that one.
Yeah, the OSIC are really in control.
You'd think the OSIC would have sent their best.
Don't worry about the Troubadour, sheriff, worry about me.
I should have given the Troubadour some professional courtesy!
Came a long way just to die here, sheriff.
You know, I like this so much, I might pay Macomb a visit later.
The lion was turned into a house cat.
No one's gonna miss a dead bartender.
Can't have you settin' me on fire now, can I?!
You outta practice, Infernus.
You never had a chance, Ivy.
Optimism was only gonna get you so far.
You never fought someone like me, Ivy.
All he could do was delay the inevitable.
Kelvin, all you managed to do was prolong your suffering.
Oathkeeper can thank me later.
I can't have you puttin' someone as fun as Oathkeeper under lock and key, Geist.
Oathkeeper deserves better, Geist.
It's over, Geist! Set Oathkeeper free.
I can't believe someone like her trapped Oathkeeper.
I've killed hundreds of men like you, Lash.
You're not special, Lash!
Your hubris is impressive, Lash.
What do I have to fear from a man like him?
Throw away your life, Lash! Makes no difference to me.
You aren't smart enough to run, McGinnis.
Machines weren't ever gonna save you, McGinnis.
I'll break all her fancy little toys!
Daddy Fairfax ain't gonna be happy he lost his favourite toy, is he?
You're outta your depth, child.
Kid like you is never gonna be Viscount.
God, I hate civilized vampires...
The Vampire Nation is a Ponzi scheme, Mina! The sooner you realize that, the better.
You're not my equal, Mina.
I see that sorry excuse for a vampire.
Noble men bleed just like any other.
Thought the Djinn would be more of a threat.
Whatever Nashala is paying him is too much.
Thought he could burrow away from me?
I love it when they're brave and stupid.
The soft-hearted are usually the first to die.
What a brave little idiot!
You're not the hero, Paige! You're the victim.
Hm, she put up more of a fight than most.
All she managed to do was prolong her suffering.
She thought she was on top, didn't she?
I love it when they think they are clever.
Paradox, you can do better than that!
I can't wait to find more of her little friends.
There's no escapin' me, Paradox.
There are worse things out there than your father, Pocket.
Pocket never had a chance.
The chase had to end eventually.
It ain't your family that you should be worrying about, Pocket.
You didn't think you were actually gonna win, did you, Pocket?
And here I was hoping to find an equal...
Seven died a lot easier than I expected.
That boy still has too much humanity left in him.
You still got a lot to learn, Seven.
I was expecting so much more from you, Seven.
You're such a disappointment, Shiv.
If you hadn't put yourself in a muzzle, maybe I'd be worried.
The Baxter Society made you soft!
You're not the man I thought you were, Shiv.
Feels Shakespearean, don't it, Shiv?
Not as much fun when they're already dead.
When's the Vatican gonna give up?
I expected more from the Sword of St. Benedict.
How many of your order do I gotta kill before you realize you can't stop me?
God ain't coming to save you, Venator.
Ain't no fun when you're just putting someone outta their misery.
He was tougher than most.
He'll sew himself up and be back.
Come back any time, Victor. I'll be ready.
Been a while since someone made me work for it like that.
Lady, you need a couple hundred years before you close to my level.
The sniper ain't a problem no more.
I'm... Not quite sure what I killed.
I'll never pretend to understand the Deep!
Flesh isn't supposed to have that texture!
Dealt with that... Goo creature.
Almost feel bad killing someone so pathetic.
No one is gonna miss her.
All your life was leading up to this moment of failure.
You trained a long time just to die here, boy!
You were never gonna be a hero, Warden! You were always destined to be a martyr.
Shame you threw your whole life away...
