I get that I'm supposed to not like her, but I can't help it!
I will make this up to you, Yamato; please don't take it personally.

name: Grey Talon
lines: I'm coming for you, Hathorne.
I won't be lectured on morality.
My story is not over yet.
I thought I had earned a peaceful life.
This will be a hunt to remember.
I can't replace what was taken from me. But I can make them answer for it.
Don't have time for the Patrons today. I have some bodies to hide.
I... still need time to mourn.
I need to investigate some things.
I have to go on a stakeout.
Can't. There's a Friends of Humanity safehouse I need to burn down.
Brake lines won't cut themselves.
Revenge is surprisingly time-consuming.
I'm not ready to summon the Patrons.
Charged Shot's almost ready!
Power Shot's on cooldown.
I won't let my family down.
Ahh, the thrill of the hunt!
I've missed being on the hunt.
I'm ready to hunt larger game!
There's no man or beast I can't bring down!
I will find their trail, and I will end them.
They'll be dead before they know it.
One arrow is all it takes!
They won't catch me flat-footed!
They will never catch me.
I must be as mobile as my prey!
These are my hunting grounds!
I won't let them catch me!
Need to use these buildings to my advantage.
I can't stay on the ground forever.
I must keep my wits about me.
Always have an escape plan.
If I stay on the ground, I'm dead.
Need to find higher ground...
Time for evasive tactics!
They won't get the drop on me.
They'll walk right into my trap.
Snares have changed over the years, haven't they?
Soon I will spring the trap.
Outwitting our enemies shouldn't be too hard.
They won't find me to be easy prey.
I'll lure them into my trap.
Who doesn't love a surprise?
This is the perfect spot.
If they come, I'll be ready.
Let's see what you catch, my friend.
They won't know what hit them.
I just need a little more time.
It's not too late to trap them!
I'll find them wherever they hide!
There's no outrunning me!
I'll find them from a lane away!
Ready to give long range support!
They will have no place to hide.
The hunt is about to get more interesting.
I don't have to be the fastest: just the most clever.
Their spirits will guide my hand.
I will not be denied my revenge.
They will learn what it means to be hunted.
I am not alone on this hunt... The spirits join with me.
I will find them; no matter where they run to!
There's no hiding from me!
Let them run. It will not save them.
My arrow will strike true!
I was expecting a challenge.
I'll kill as many of them as I have to.
Your arrogance was noted.
And you thought you were the apex predator.
It's always satisfying taking someone off their pedestal.
You stirred up something in me that was best left sleeping.
Together, we can do great things.
It's all coming together.
Walk away while you still have the chance!
No one will stand between me and my revenge!
I don't have the luxury of mercy today!
They will fall. One. By. One.
I have enough arrows for all of you!
New York is my hunting grounds.
You will drown in the blood of your allies!
I'm not afraid to die! Are you?
Today is a day for bloody retribution!
The death I bring today is nothing compared to what lies in store for Hathorne!
How much blood must I bathe in before you give up?!
Their bullets will do nothing!
I can call on the spirits again!
Preparing to block their magic!
Dampening arrows are ready!
Your abilities mean nothing!
I can empower my abilities.
I should train my powers.
Might be time to invest in my abilities.
I should check out the store.
It might be time to get an item.
I wonder what else I can buy.
I should see what I can afford now.
Perhaps I should spend what I have.
It might be time to use these souls.
I can get something of quality.
There must be something I can buy.
There's nothing I can't afford.
If I want to summon the Patron, I need to be well equipped.
It's time to go back to the Curiosity Shop.
I shouldn't leave those souls lying around.
I need to pick up those souls.
The souls will be useful.
Waging war isn't exactly cheap.
We'll summon the Patron soon enough.
Soon the ritual will be complete.
We took the objective. That's what matters.
The ritual is one step closer to being complete.
Prey is around here somewhere.
They couldn't have gotten far.
They won't get lucky next time.
They won't escape me again.
It's time for discretion. Not valour.
I need to find a place to rest.
I need to stop cutting it so close.
They're not making this easy.
Just because I can't see them doesn't mean they aren't here.
And once again I am alone.
I'll hold on for as long as I can.
There's too many of them!
This might not be the right time to engage.
I can't help anyone if I throw my life away.
They have the Rejuvenator!
They picked up the Rejuvenator!
They're going to try to put the pressure on us!
I can't let them fight my battle!
It's time to complete the ritual!
Don't waste your bullets!
The hunt is about to begin.
I hope you all have the will to do what needs to be done.
Today they die many deaths.
We don't have the luxury of failure today.
Today my grandkids will be paid in blood.
I will do whatever it takes to complete the ritual.
Maybe now I can find peace.
All roads led to this moment.
Time to make my demand of the Patron.
I couldn't have done this without your help.
Run through them, Abrams!
This isn't going to end well for them.
Billy's going to get himself killed, isn't he?
I can't believe I'm working with him...
I'll be back soon, professor!
They stopped the professor!
I knew I could count on you.
The Baxter Society could use someone like you, Haze.
The OSIC trained you well.
Holliday's brought us a victim!
It's an honour to work with you, Infernus.
How I've missed the children of Ixia...
This was the first of many victories!
I see why you're beloved, Ivy.
Thanks for the help, Ivy.
I'm counting on you, Kelvin!
I thought I was really in trouble for a minute.
You really came through, Kelvin.
They didn't realise they were walking into a trap.
There goes a useful idiot...
I see why Lash has his ego.
I'll be back when I can, McGinnis.
Smart thinking, McGinnis.
I like the way you think, McGinnis!
They didn't even have a chance.
Don't get too cocky, Mina.
She moved them out of position!
Do what you have to do, Seven!
Seven butchered them all.
I can still smell the ozone...
You're a credit to the Baxter Society.
The Baxter Society is lucky to have you, Shiv.
You'll do the Baxter Society well, Shiv.
They really need to stop bickering with each other.
I'll help when I can, Vindicta!
I will avenge you, Vindicta!
I don't know if I could have made that shot.
I hope that thing knows what it's doing.
Oh. That's... kind of nice.
So this is the Cube I've heard so much about.
Fight to the bitter end, Warden!
Warden is a man possessed!
I'll come back when I can, Wraith!
That was impressive, Yamato.
I brought down the detective!
I wish there was another way.
Any other day and we could've been allies.
You gave me no choice Abrams!
Help me kill the detective!
I won't be denied by a machine!
I won't let you stop me, Bebop!
Word of advice: never make yourself a stationary target.
And all you did was throw your life away, Bebop!
I thought automatons were supposed to be clever?
One day you'll learn what real anger feels like, Billy.
You're not a rebel, Billy. You're just an asshole.
I was content to leave you alone, Calico. Why did you have to come here?
What happened to you, Calico?
I wish it didn't have to be this way.
She gave up on her ideals for something as pointless as money.
I don't want to fight you, Calico!
Sorry, Doorman. It wasn't personal.
The Baroness is backing the wrong Patron, Doorman.
Return to the Baroness while you still can.
You should never have left the hotel, Doorman.
I've waited for this, Drifter.
I wasn't expecting to see the Drifter here, but I'm glad he showed up to get what's coming to him!
I won't let you ruin any more lives, Drifter!
You don't belong here, professor.
You're not ready for this fight, professor.
He belongs in the classroom, not the battlefield!
You have spirit Dynamo, but spirit isn't enough!
Your wife needs you alive, Dynamo. Stop this madness!
Keep your eye on the professor!
I won't let the government get in my way.
I didn't want to fight the OSIC, but I'll do what I must.
Your dream-walking days are over, Haze.
You can't hide from me, Haze.
I won't let the law stand in my way!
Go back home while you still can, Holliday.
You can't run from me, sheriff.
I didn't expect her to be a coward.
Death waits for you, sheriff.
I didn't want to spill more Ixian blood!
Why are you helping them, Infernus?
Infernus won't be bothering us for a while.
You were a noble woman, Ivy.
I took no pleasure in that, Ivy.
You have a good heart, Ivy... But good hearts don't win wars.
I'll get the gargoyle later.
The dead belong in the ground.
Kelvin, I'll give you the peace you seek.
Quit while you still can, Kelvin.
There is no mercy for you today, Kelvin!
At least you made me work for it, Kelvin.
I have no patience for those who prey on others.
Oathkeeper dies with you.
Oathkeeper needs to be destroyed.
Don't get close to Geist!
Geist is looking to swap.
Geist is ready to steal your health!
Your hubris got you killed, Lash.
I tire of your games, Lash.
Thanks for making me smile, Lash.
Poor, predictable Lash...
Your machines will never stop me!
Your little war toys will never be enough!
That woman is proving to be a problem.
How many turrets does that woman have?!
I'll tear through your machines to get to you, McGinnis!
Oh, the misplaced arrogance of youth.
Young vampires are always the stupidest.
Her confidence was misplaced.
So much for being immortal.
The Djinn are on the wrong side today.
You should find another career.
You can't stop me, Krill.
I can't let you get in my way, Krill.
I took out their support.
She won't be shielding her allies anymore.
Not all stories have happy endings.
This isn't the place for you, Paige!
You're in over your head, kid.
I have no time for games, Paradox.
I won't be stopped by the likes of you, Paradox!
Took down the time thief!
Try your tricks somewhere else.
Paradox, all you did was delay the inevitable!
I'm done playing games, Paradox.
The fox can only outrun the hunter for so long.
You picked the wrong man to toy with.
Pocket... you forced my hand.
How many lives must I take for this madness to end?
You won't find your destiny here, Pocket: only death.
There's no escaping me, Pocket!
I dedicated my life to killing things like you, Seven.
You may have outsmarted the law, but you'll never outsmart me.
Men like you are as predictable as they are cliché, Seven!
Justice doesn't come swiftly, but it always comes for people like you.
And here I thought you could replace me, Shiv.
It seems I chose my replacement poorly.
Even the Baxter Society turns its back on me...
In time you'll be great... But that day isn't today.
You still have much to learn, Shiv.
Wish the Venator was fighting for us.
I've seen a few venators in my time... that one was angrier than most.
So much for a friendly rivalry.
Killed the vampire hunter.
I won't let you get in my way, Victor!
Corpses are such a pain in the ass to kill.
I wish you luck in your search, but you are not winning today.
Why did you turn on me, Vindicta?!
I thought we wanted the same thing, Vindicta.
I didn't want to do this, Vindicta!
I thought she was my friend...
Only one of us gets vengeance today.
Take cover from Vindicta!
You are not a predator; just a target.
Return to the Deep, Viscous.
That... goo thing... never had a chance against me.
I'm not as frail as I look, Vyper.
What a contemptible woman.
You prey on the weak, Vyper. I won't stand for it!
Should've stayed in jail, Vyper.
I appreciate your conviction, Warden.
The world isn't black and white, Warden!
Your obsession will be your undoing, Warden.
Warden is out of commission!
You picked the wrong time to chose a side.
Greed got the best of you, Wraith.
You're not half as clever as you think you are, Wraith!
You never had a chance against me, Wraith.
I am sorry that you failed your brother.
Yamato is no longer a threat!
She'll be looking for revenge soon.

name: Haze
lines: They won't see me coming.
I'm here on OSIC business.
I dedicated my life to the OSIC. I won't fail them.
I am the bright light's dark shadow.
No more waiting. The time is now.
You know it's bad when they send a Sandman.
Every one of our enemies will die.
My services are needed once more.
Bring your best. It won't be enough.
You don't want a Sandman's help?
Your enemies are grateful for your choice.
When you need some finesse, I'll be ready.
More time to find my next target.
It won't be long before I'm given a target.
Ready to use Sleep Dagger.
Sleep Dagger's on cooldown.
They will sleep, and they will die.
Death will come for them as they sleep.
No one can resist my will.
They will know what it feels to be helpless.
I will bring down the mightiest warrior.
Even the mighty need to sleep.
With coordination, this can be deadly.
Sometimes the simpliest tricks are the most effective.
I need some breathing room!
Smoke Bomb's on cooldown.
The shadows protect their own.
They'll never see me coming.
I'll stride through my enemies.
There's no place I can't breach.
Weak minds can never catch me.
They won't see me until it's too late.
I'll slip right through them.
Only the cunning will survive.
I need to live, so they may die!
Once I pick a target, there is no escaping me.
I'll bring them down, one at a time.
Blood will be spilt today.
I've been forged into a weapon.
I won't stop until they're dead.
Ready to mow them all down.
I'm ready for the next team fight.
Say the word and I'll dance through them.
Blood is ready to be spilt.
Bullet Dance is almost ready.
Bullet Dance is on cooldown.
Mercy is not a gift that I bring today.
I'll dance through my enemies.
This is why sandmen are feared.
The OSIC trained me well.
Bullets will rain down on them.
Every single one of them will die.
I will dance... And they will die.
I will tear through their army.
The air will be filled with their screams.
I'm just getting started.
You were a fool to get close to me.
I don't need my guns to kill you.
You should have tried to parry.
Your time in the sun has passed.
You had your fun, now it's time to pay!
Just wait until I get going.
This is the beginning of something beautiful.
Keep throwing your lives away. I'll be ready.
Today, there will be a reaping.
Challenge me and meet the same fate.
I'll show you what power really looks like.
You've been sanctioned by the OSIC.
No one among you can stop me.
The Sandman comes for you all.
There's no escaping death by my hand.
Time to step outside my comfort zone!
I'm not afraid of a firefight.
I'm ready to dance again.
The bullets will rain down.
I am one with the shadows.
They'll be powerless soon.
My guns will silence them.
Their magic is about to be useless.
I can improve my techniques.
I need to continue my training.
Time to buy some tools of the trade.
Might want to get a new item.
There's some decent gear I can buy.
The more tools I have, the better.
I can buy some impressive gear.
Might be time to visit the store.
I should see what relics I can afford.
I can afford anything in the store.
Souls do me no good if I don't spend them.
I can get the finest tools of the trade!
You think I'm not trained in hand-to-hand combat?!
You'll need to try harder than that.
That could have been bad.
I shouldn't leave loose souls lying around.
Someone should claim those souls.
This will help fund the work.
Someone must have missed this.
I'd be a fool to leave this behind.
I'll take every opportunity I can for an edge.
The ritual is closer to completion.
We won't stop until we're victorious!
Face your death with some courage.
You think you're clever, but you're only delaying the inevitable.
They can't escape me forever.
I'll have another chance to take them out.
I didn't think they were smart enough to run.
They knew they were outmatched.
Judgement will come for them later.
Always have an escape plan.
I'll come back and finish things later.
I'm a soldier, not a martyr.
Just want to make sure that I'm getting the drop on them, and not the other way around...
I need to buy my allies time!
Not sure I can kill them all.
Ah, there's a lot of them.
I need to be wise in how I approach this.
Now's our chance to push the advantage.
They have the Rejuvenator!
Be careful! They took the Rejuvenator.
My hands have been clean for far too long.
Time to make them suffer!
I'll force my will on them.
The job's not finished yet.
Bullets aren't going to work!
You're on your own for now.
I have other work to tend to.
I need to find a place to recover.
The sooner we finish the ritual, the sooner I get the paperwork filled out.
If they were smart, they'd walk away now.
This is their last chance to surrender.
This assignment keeps getting weirder.
I won't let the OSIC down.
The OSIC appreciates your help.
Another task done to perfection.
Like lambs to the slaughter.
Our defenses will tear them apart!
They took out the goat man!
You played your role to perfection, Dynamo.
Just what I needed, Dynamo.
You're an artist with that bow.
Talon was looking out for us.
Keep your wits about you, sheriff.
Following your lead, Holliday.
Hold them still, Holliday!
Be with you soon, Infernus.
We tore through that objective.
We make this look easy, don't we, Ivy?
Ivy, we keep this up and it will be over soon.
If we keep working together, they don't have a chance.
Help Geist finish them off!
Show 'em what you got, Lash.
You know how to make an entrance, Lash.
I'll be back when I can, McGinnis.
Thanks for the set-up, McGinnis.
Thanks for the heal, McGinnis.
Your timing is impeccable.
They took out the vampire.
I'll be back soon, Mirage.
Don't get into too much trouble.
Let's keep isolating them, one at a time.
We made short work of them, didn't we, Krill?
That woman's going to be trouble.
Good positioning, Paradox.
Clever, Paradox. Very clever.
I have my eye on you, Shiv.
I love watching him work.
How is he still standing?
I get why the Baxter Society puts up with him.
Wonder which Sinclair is driving the body?
Vindicta isn't going to show mercy.
You have talent, Vindicta.
They never saw that coming, did they?
I'll help when I can, Viscous.
Remember your training, Warden.
Now that's a man with conviction!
All that training paid off, Warden.
We make a good team, Wraith.
Yamato can take care of herself.
You're relentless, Yamato.
The detective is no longer a threat.
Tough. But not tough enough.
Not even the Tome could save him.
You'll fall eventually, Abrams.
Washington is going to be thrilled...
This is gonna be tough to explain to Marlowe.
Wonder who we're going to frame for this.
You expected this would be easy, Bebop.
I will never lose to a machine.
You never had a chance against me, Bebop.
You're a sitting duck, Bebop.
You've been outmanoeuvred, Bebop.
That the best you got, Bebop?
Yelling about something is different than fighting for something, isn't it, Billy?
You wanted the OSIC's attention, Billy? You have it.
Calico has been dealt with.
We have nothing to fear from Calico.
Calico could only evade me for so long.
Calico got what she deserved.
That woman died as she lived.
That's enough whimsy for one day.
The OSIC is gonna want an autopsy.
Marlowe is going to want to hear about this.
Looks like the OSIC is going to have to intervene at the Baroness.
You overstepped, Doorman.
I don't wanna know what that guy dreams about.
It's a good thing I was here.
New York isn't your hunting ground anymore.
Drifter's been neutralised.
Looks like the viscount is going to owe the OSIC a favour.
That should make the office happy.
The professor has been neutralized.
I don't take pleasure in this, Dynamo.
We don't need to worry about the professor for a while.
Looks like Dynamo needs a new body.
Stay out of my way, professor.
He's going to drop a black hole!
Look out for the black hole!
The necromancer's been dealt with.
We really need a law about not raising the dead until you're 21.
Looks like someone forgot what they learnt in the scare programme.
You got a warrior's death, Wesley.
New York isn't the place for you, Holliday.
Your grandfather was a legend. You, however, are a disappointment.
You're out of your depth, Holliday.
Leave the Troubadour to the OSIC.
The professionals will take it from here, Holliday.
Run while you can, sheriff.
Bounce away like the coward you are!
You can't run forever, Holliday.
Get this thing off of me!
I won't let you burn down this city.
You should have stayed retired, Infernus.
Leaving that bar was the last mistake you'll ever make.
Nothing personal, Infernus.
I appreciate your courage, Infernus.
Too little, too late, Infernus.
This'll be a PR nightmare...
I wish I didn't have to do that.
You didn't give me another choice, Ivy.
You can't fly forever, Ivy.
Well done, little gargoyle. We'll meet again.
Respect to you, Kelvin. You put up a fight.
You're well trained, but not trained enough.
It's adorable that you thought that dome of yours would stop me.
There's no running from me, Kelvin.
You won't escape me, Kelvin.
Geist and her shackled specter will be back.
Getting on our radar was a mistake, Geist.
Geist is no longer an issue.
Geist will try to drain you!
Geist is going to try to swap!
Don't let Geist steal your health!
You'll answer for every soul you took.
You're a leech, Geist, and your time is over.
And you thought you were unkillable, didn't you, Geist?
It's about time you met a real warrior.
All your little tricks weren't enough to stop me.
You got what you deserved, Lash.
You're making this too easy, Lash.
I expected more from you, Lash.
That oughtta shut him up.
Your turrets couldn't save you.
Only a coward hides behind machines.
Impressive mind, frail spirit.
McGinnis, you've had your chance to make the right choice.
Today, you reap what you sowed, McGinnis.
You expect those turrets to fight for you?
Build as many of those machines as you want, they won't help you.
Your tin soldiers aren't holding up, McGinnis.
Killed the vampire upstart.
You have a lot to learn, Mina.
Looks like the viscount is going to owe us some favours.
You're not in charge, Mina, we are.
How dare the Djinn try to circumvent official channels?
I know what you're up to, Mirage.
This isn't the way for the Djinn to get what they want.
You're impressive, Mirage, but you're not better than me.
Hope you dug yourself a grave.
Your tunneling days are over.
Someone shoot this mole man!
A shame. She would've made a good curator.
Stop trying to play hero, Paige.
Let your brother go, Paige. You'll be happier.
Go home while you still can, Paige.
Paradox should know better than to interfere with us.
Paradox will die with you.
You're no queen of thieves. You're just another target.
Did you think you had an edge?
Did she think that would work?
Pocket has been dealt with.
You have powerful enemies, Pocket.
I'm sorry I couldn't protect you.
I'm just following protocol.
Wish there was another way.
Seven has been dealt with.
I've had my eye on Seven for a while.
I'll tell you a secret, Seven: I've dreamed of this moment.
You hid yourself from me for the last time.
Your nightmare has come to an end.
With proper training, you could be so much more, Shiv.
Your knife skills need some work.
You were never going to beat me.
And he thought he knew how to use a knife.
Someone stop Shiv from healing.
The lycan isn't a threat.
Stopped the bounty hunter.
Threat's been neutralised.
Don't stand in the OSIC's way.
This isn't the place for you, Sinclair.
The picked the wrong side, father.
A shame. The other Venators I met were more reasonable.
You can't help but admire his commitment.
Go back to Europe, father. The OSIC has it from here.
Self-pity doesn't suit you, Victor.
Put down the cadaver man.
She wasn't an avenger, she was a domestic terrorist!
Vindicta's been sanctioned.
I can't let Vindicta take me out!
Alright. Maybe Vindicta's a better shot than I thought.
What chance did you have, Viscous?
That cube was never going to save you.
All you could do was try to delay the inevitable.
Turns out bullets kill goo just fine.
To think the OSIC was worried about your kind.
She should have stayed in jail and saved us all some time.
You'll never be better than me, Vyper.
Normally, cretins like her are beneath my pay grade.
Vyper, you didn't have a chance in hell.
Vigilantes are just criminals with delusions of grandeur.
New York doesn't need you, Warden. I'm here.
And you thought you could impose your will on me.
You're strong, Warden. I'm just stronger.
Don't get too close to Warden.
You had your fun, Wraith.
How long did you think you'd escape the OSIC's notice, Wraith?
Finally, a worthy target.
You're good. Just not good enough.
You should've run, Wraith.
Pray I don't survive this, Wraith!
I'll make you suffer for this, Wraith!
Yamato, The Seventh Moon's time is at an end.
It's time for the Seventh Moon to leave New York.
It was always going to lead to this, Yamato.
You couldn't hide from me forever, Yamato.

name: Holliday
lines: I never got to meet my grandpa, but I know I'll make him proud.
You can only run from the law for so long.
When I find who I'm looking for, I'm not bringing him in. I'm putting him down.
I let my town down once, but I'm gonna make it right today.
Justice isn't always swift, but it comes for everyone.
I'll complete the ritual, and I'll find who I'm looking for.
I'm not leaving New York until I stop the Troubadour!
If I'm gonna stop that sick bastard, I'm gonna need the Patron's help.
The sooner I stop the Troubadour, the sooner I can go back home.
I don't have time to mess around with the ritual, lives are at stake!
I should, uh... check in with people back home.
I got a lead on the Troubadour that I need to follow up on.
If you change your mind, I'll be around.
Heard reports another body was found. I need to investigate.
Sounds like my investigation is rubbing people the wrong way.
You got my hopes up. Hope you're happy.
Come on, don't put me on the shelf!
At this rate, this case is never gonna get solved!
Time for a little fun with TNT.
Can't wait to play with these.
I got a permit for these.
This'll send a message...
Now's not the time for subtlety.
I'll do whatever it takes.
It's all fun and games until someone kicks a barrel of explosives at ya.
I brought a little surprise from back home.

Sometimes you have to make your own opportunities.
I'll help out however I can.
No es una granada, pero es mejor que na'. (It's not a grenade, but it's better than nothing.)
This might keep them at bay.
The slower they are, the better.
Lo conseguiré! (I will do it!)
Tirando espinas! (Throwing thorns!)
¡No te dejaré ganar! (I won't let you win!)
¡Oh, por Dios, muérete! (Oh, for God's sake, die!)
Time to make some friends!
If I find the right ally, this will be over soon.
Hope I'm working with some team players.
I'll give my allies the chance to shine!
All we need now is a little coordination.
I hope these people know how to use this.
Like Carlos says: you can make opportunities, but you can't make people take them.
The team's counting on me.
Stone Form's almost ready!
Stone Form's on cooldown.
This can buy me some time.
Being a statue isn't riveting, but it beats being killed!
I'm no good to anyone dead.
I can take care of myself.
Esto debería ayudarme. (This should help me.)
What can I say, I'm a work of art!
I'm not just going to crush them: I'm going to look good doing it!
No one will be able to harm me!
I hope I don't need to use this.
They think they're in control?
This story isn't over yet!
They're not bringing me down!
I'm not going down without a fight!
Creen que están ganando? (You think you are winning?)
Necesitas mucho más que eso para matarme. (You'll need a lot more than that to kill me.)
Let me know if you need me to fly in!
Say the word and I can fly in!
God, I hope I get to fly to mid.
Best way to get around the city!
Sometimes, friends need a lift.
Everyone should get the chance to fly.
The Arroyos always get a kick out of this!
Hope you don't mind the pickup!
¡No voy a morir aquí! (I'm not going to die here!)
¡Ya! ¡Me voy ahora! (Come on! I'm leaving now!)
¡Nadie amenaza a mis amigos! (Nobody threatens my friends!)
Lo siento, chacho. (Sorry, dude.)
You're not completing the ritual!
Gotta try harder than that.
Thought they'd be tougher.
Elegiste la pelea equivocada. (You picked the wrong fight.)
I'd stay down, if I were you.
¡Quédate ahí! (Stay there!)
You tried to punch a gargoyle? Really?!
Well, they had Moxie! I mean, they're dead, but... Moxie!
You think just because you have money you can bully people?!
You think you run this place?
You never should have come here!
Este será un dia largo para tí! (This will be a long day for you!)
Apenas estoy empezando! (I'm just getting started!)
I won't let you hurt my friends!
I'll do whatever it takes to protect my team!
I bet Sophie and Manny would get a kick out of watching me win!
New York is under my protection!
You guys really need to stop fighting me.
I don't know what to tell you, I'm just better at this than you!
I'll block their healing!
Go ahead and waste your bullets!
I'll give it everything I got!
Can't forget to train my abilities.
I need to improve my powers.
Buying a relic could be a good idea.
Might be time to pick up a relic.
Wonder what I can afford now?
Bet there's something good in the shop!
I probably should spend this.
Now I get some quality gear!
I could pick up something nice at the store.
I should check out the store.
Going shopping could be a game changer.
Gotta lotta souls to spend!
Maybe it's time to buy some real power.
No tienes lo que se necesita. (You don't have what it takes.)
¡Los detuve! (I stopped them!)
¡Mejor suerte luego! (Better luck later!)
Someone dropped some souls!
More souls is always good!
Who says vigilante work doesn't pay the bills?
The ritual is one step closer.
We took another objective!
They can keep the money! We got what we came for.
They couldn't have gotten far.
Where the hell did they go?
¡Y no te vuelves! (And don't come back!)
That should buy me some time!
That coulda gone real bad.
¡Gracias, adiós! (Thank you, goobye!)
I had to get outta there!
Might want to get with the others.
I don't like being this exposed!
Aw man, looks like it's all up to me...
¡Uy, esto es malo! (Oh, this is bad!)
I'll do my best to buy us some time!
Oh boy, there's a lotta them...
I'm not liking this math.
We have the Rejuvenator! What's the plan?
Great job getting the Rejuvenator!
They have the Rejuvenator!
Let's regroup and form a plan!
It's time to complete the ritual!
Es nuestro tiempo ahora. (It's our time now.)
¡Ahora terminamos lo que empezamos! (Now we finish what we started!)
Don't bother shooting them!
I knew this was going to work out!
I'm feeling good about this!
So, how are we feeling about this?
Stick close to me, I'll do my best to protect you.
Oh man, Carlos is going to be worried about me.
We need to make this quick: It's Mofongo night.
I hope I don't get Sophie's professor killed.
This is probably less stressful than a shift at the diner.
I need to get back to the Arroyos.
Great teamwork, everyone!
That could have gone real bad!
I'm just glad we survived in one piece!
Abrams is leading the charge!
They're by the objective!
You're a lifesaver, professor!
Sophie was right, you are the best!
Oh man, I don't know what I would do without you, professor.
I don't know how you landed that.
Someone's been practising.
¡Gracias a Dios por ese búho! (Thank goodness for that owl!)
Thanks, Grey Talon, wherever you are.
I get why OSIC hired her.
Thank God you were here, Haze!
We make a hell of a team!
Hey, Kevin... Kelvin! Your name's Kelvin!
Thanks for taking care of me, Kelvin.
Keep... Stealing souls, Geist!
Remind me not to piss her off.
Lash is ruining their day!
Hate to be on the receiving end of that.
Thanks for the help, McGinnis!
I was getting worried for a minute.
Stay safe out there, Pocket.
Thanks for being on our team, Seven.
¡Bendito Dios, Seven! (Good Lord, Seven!)
I've never seen power like that!
¡Me encanta ese tipo! (I love that guy!)
He's like a shampoo ad with knifes!
Have fun shooting people!.. Oh God, I made that weird.
I don't know how you hit that!
I'll be right back, Viscous!
I kind of like it in The Cube!
That guy looked intense...
Thanks for holding them, Wraith.
Arigato! A-did I say that right?!
That woman is scary as hell!
I thought you were one of the good guys, Abrams!
Whew! Finally took out the big guy!
Someone stop Abrams from healing!
Maybe you should just... spend some time with Ms. Shelly.
We're going back to the junkyard.
Gotta be faster than that, Bebop.
I used to think goats were cute.
I won't let you stop me, Billy!
You can't blame the world for your problems, Billy!
You're not picking off my friends, Calico!
Don't worry, Calico. I'm sure the Arroyos will adopt Ava.
There's the crazy cat lady!
Aw man, the Baroness had such a great brunch, too.
Perdón, Mr. Doorman. (Sorry, Mr. Doorman.)
I'm pretty sure that's not a normal doorman.
I might want to tell Carlos and Maria to cancel their date night at the Baroness.
Leave New York while you can, Drifter!
You're never going to win, Drifter!
I won't let you hurt anyone else!
You're finished, Drifter!
I think I just beat up Sophie's professor.
Please don't take that out on Sophie, Professor!
Look out for the black hole!
I wanted to respect my elders, but you kinda gave me no choice!
Not a fan of being shot with arrows!
That bow was never going to get it done.
I think I just picked a fight with the feds.
Carlos isn't gonna be wild about me fighting the OSIC.
You're not as sly as you think, Haze.
You can't run from me, Haze!
Normally I'd help you, Holliday. Lo siento. (I'm sorry.)
I'm not letting her lasso me!
And there she goes bouncing away.
I won't let you burn this city down!
What do you think you're doing, Infernus?
Not fast enough, Infernus!
That could have gone bad real quick.
The dead should stay buried.
You gotta be a lot faster than that, Kelvin.
People like her make the world a worse place.
I can't let someone like her win!
Geist is looking to steal your life!
You're not unkillable, Geist!
Finally put down Lady Geist!
So she's killable after all.
Huh. Lash really is an asshole.
You learned your lesson, Lash?
Better luck next time, Lash!
¡Sigue chavando! (Keep on pestering!)
Buddy, you were supposed to be some genius!
You don't have enough turrets to stop me!
How many of these things does she have?!
Keep building these all you want, McGinnis, they won't stop me!
I'll tear through as many of these as I have to!
The vampire's been dealt with!
Mina, you don't have to be so nasty to everyone!
Hope Sophia doesn't end up like her.
Vampires are a lot more fun when you're reading about them, and they're not trying to kill you.
Mirage shouldn't be a problem for a while.
He'll be back. Need to be careful.
I got nothing against the Djinn, but I can't let you win.
Don't know which is Mo and which is Krill, but they're dead.
One less mole-man to worry about!
The Tunnel Rats are down!
You're not grabbing my friends!
I thought they'd be cuddly... They weren't.
And she was so nice when I took Manny to story hour!
You're a great storyteller, Paige!
We should start a book club after this!
Chacho, I feel kinda bad about doing that to her. (Man)
I am so sick of that lady!
Paradox's been dealt with!
That was never going to finish me off, Paradox!
It'll take a lot more than that, Paradox!
This isn't over yet, Paradox!
Sorry about that, Pocket!
I feel like Pocket just needs a hug.
Pocket shouldn't be bothering us for a while.
Wonder what's in the case!
I'm just saying, "Siete" is about as un-intimidating a name as it gets.
I can't let that monster summon the Patron!
I won't be hunted by you!
What kind of moron tries to stab stone?
Get out of my city, Shiv!
I, uh... I probably shouldn't tell the Arroyos about this.
Maria isn't hearing about this.
Sooo, the Vatican sent an assassin? That's... great.
Glad I survived that fight.
Nothing personal, Victor.
That guy's having a rough day.
I'll help you after the ritual, Victor, but for now, I have to stop you.
Stopped the walking corpse!
I bet I could get Carlos to lend you a shirt.
Vindicta's out of commission!
You don't rule the skies!
You're a coward, Vindicta!
She won't be happy about that!
The skies are my dominion!
You can't escape me, Vindicta!
And she thought she was safe!
That was one big pile of goo.
That thing is like if Manny's science fair project gained sentience.
Ay, qué rebolo! (Ah, what a mess!)
I stopped you when you worked for Mendoza, and I'll stop you again!
Took down the petty criminal!
Lady, just turn yourself in and save us some time!
That guy needs to lighten up.
Someone's wound up tight!
You won't stop me from summoning the Patron, Warden!
Don't let Warden get close to you!
You criminals are all the same!
You don't run New York, Wraith!
Take your card tricks somewhere else!
I don't know what she was saying, but she scared the hell out of me.
Stay out of Spanish Harlem!
I took out Mendoza, and I'll take out you!
¡Correr, run! (Run, run!)

name: Kelvin
lines: Let's get started, shall we?
I'm feeling good about this, yes?
The anticipation... oh, it's exciting, yes?
Look at us. A couple of miscreants, ready to take on the world!
It may be the single malt but, I'm feeling very optimistic.
In life, I find that a positive outlook - and a freeze ray - makes all the difference in the world.
This is dangerous work. Fortunately, I'm dangerously handsome.
I love making new friends and even newer enemies!
United, no one can break us!
Ah, well, good luck to you and your future endeavours!
A pity we won't be working together.
If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
My... condition... will have to wait. I have other matters to attend to.
I need to see the families of my crewmates.
Answers will have to wait. I have a year of lost time to make up for.
Look at you, throwing caution to the wind!
Most people would think it's suicide to go into a battle without me, but you are an individual with no fear of looming failure, and I respect it.
Looks like I have time to finally work on that jigsaw puzzle that's been haunting me for months!
I've had my fill of the supernatural for now.
Frost Grenade's almost ready.
Ice Grenade's on cooldown!
Ice bombs! Always a classic.
If it doesn't kill 'em, it'll slow them down.
I need to deal with groups.
When the waves come, I'll be ready.
These should keep them at bay.
This will help with engagement.
It's like a snowball... If snowballs could explode and kill your neighbours.
What's the point of being a scientist if you don't get to blow things up?!
I've learned many things in my travels.
This fight will continue!
I must be ready to give chase!
It pays to have an exit strategy.
I bring Rockefeller Plaza wherever I go.
I can go anywhere in this city.
Strange times require strange solutions.
Who knows where the magic ends, and the science begins!
A chill wind is about to blow.
The streets are for suckers!
This city is my playground!
Arctic Beam's almost ready.
Oh, they really hate it when I use this!
Now, aside from my devastating good looks, this is what else I'm known for.
Mmm, my bread and butter!
Being an Ice Wight has its advantages.
Soon, they will run from me!
This is why I was chosen!
They will die a frozen death.
Only I can bear the Arctic chill safely.
It's pointless to resist.
Ready to use Frozen Shelter!
Ready to build an ice dome!
We'll be safe in my ice dome!
Ready to build the Frozen Shelter!
Nothing will get through my ice dome!
When the time comes, I'll build a shelter.
Ready to trap them in my ice dome!
Frozen Shelter's back online!
Frozen Shelter's almost ready!
Frozen Shelter's on cooldown!
My friends will be protected!
This should keep me safe!
I will isolate them from their friends!
I'll fight them on my terms!
I will shape the battlefield!
I have a few tricks up my sleeve!
Hope they wore something warm!
It's about to get cold out there!
I'll trap them soon enough.
Let's see how you fare now!
And where, pray tell, do you think you're going?
I won't meet my final debt!
Thought you had me, didn't you?
All I need is a little more time!
I'm protecting the shrine!
Damn it! I froze the objective.
Argh, that was horrible timing!
No one's getting the Rejuvenator but us!
You were outmatched, my friend.
Don't feel bad, my friend, no one is better than me.
If you're going to lose, at least you lost to the best, yes?
They throw their lives away with such gusto!
It appears they have confused courage with stupidity!
Admit it, you're outmatched!
You asked for this fight, my friend.
I had no choice but to defend myself!
You really shouldn't be surprised.
It's in your best interest to stay down.
They may have the money, but we have the talent.
All good things come to an end.
If someone's going to kill me, it's going to be Ettrick, not you.
I knew we could work together!
See what teamwork brings?
We keep this up, and it will be over in no time!
We make a good team, yes?
It would appear that I'm on a roll, yes?
Things keep going my way!
It's not your fault that you're not better than me. It's just is what it is!
If only Ettrick could see me now.
Will none of you rise to the challenge?!
Show me some courage, people!
I came to fight the best, and so far... Eh, I'm sorely disappointed.
Ugh. I almost feel bad for them.
There's no shame in surrender, friends.
This should soften them up.
They won't heal so easily!
Your bullets mean nothing!
Let me deal with their magic!
Their powers won't help them!
I don't fear their powers!
Ready to heal from their pain!
So this is what being Lady Geist feels like.
Ready to improve my powers.
My powers can be upgraded.
I can strengthen my abilities.
I gotta get to the store.
Hm, might want to get some gear.
I can buy some better gear now.
Maybe now's the time to go shopping.
I can afford better equipment.
I should spend these souls.
I can afford some quality merchandise.
Ah, I can get some high tier equipment!
There's nothing I can't get at the shop!
I wonder what they have at the Curiosity Shop?
This is the moment I've been saving for!
You overextended yourself.
That's... Not going to happen.
There are loose souls about!
I'll put these souls to good use.
Can't leave souls lying around now, can we?!
Hm, if no one's going to claim it... I might as well!
Who am I to say no to free souls!
Ha, no sense letting this go to waste!
No worries, friends. We got the objective.
The objective is no more!
The objective has fallen!
We're closer to summoning the Patron!
Where are you, my friend?
Come out and face me with courage!
Only a rat feels the need to hide!
It's getting a little rough out there.
They'll have to try harder than that if they want to kill me.
Today is not the day I die.
Urgh, I need to be careful.
I need to stay sharp, I don't have any backup!
And once again... I am all alone.
Don't worry, friends. I'll do my best to slow them down.
I won't let the team down.
Urgh, I don't like how the numbers are looking.
There's nothing to be gained by charging into a fight where I'm outnumbered!
Now that we have the Rejuvenator, what's our plan?
They have the Rejuvenator!
They picked up the Rejuv, we can't afford to make mistakes!
I must help my new friends!
No one can win this battle on their own!
I will support my allies!
Don't waste your bullets!
You're on your own for now!
Urgh, this battle is taking it's toll!
So, friends, who among you is ready to summon an Elder God?
This will be an expedition to remember!
I have been given a second chance at life, and I won't squander it.
I'm so close to finding the answers I seek!
We don't have to like each other, but we need to work together as a team.
Once the Ritual begins, there's no time for fear or second guesses.
We fought with courage, and now we reap the rewards!
The answers to my condition will no longer elude me.
They fought well, but it wasn't enough.
Together we were unstoppable!
They can't stop you, Abrams!
Don't stop fighting, Abrams!
Bebop is pulling them in!
Well done, you beautiful golem!
The guardians will deal with them.
I knew I could count on you, old friend.
I wish I had you on the expedition!
You know how to use a bow, sir!
Thanks for the help, Grey Talon!
Talon was looking out for us.
So that's what the OSIC does.
Remind me never to get on her hit list!
Turns out the government actually is here to help! Hm!
Your reputation is well-earned, Haze!
Now that was some finesse!
They took out the sheriff!
I'll follow you, Holliday.
I love working with you, Infernus.
He made short work of that!
Damn it, they took out Ivy!
Ivy, I knew I could depend on you.
Ivy, it's always a pleasure.
They were fools for getting close to her!
They're cursing Lady Geist's name for sure!
Thanks for the help, Lash!
You know how to make an enterance, Lash!
I admit, that was impressive.
McGinnis, you beautiful immoral bastard!
Give the mole man a hand!
You're a wily one, Paradox!
He's as dangerous as they said... But at least he's on our side.
That man is power personified!
That's... probably why the Baxter Society never kicked him out.
Even his hair still looks perfect!
The man's a force of nature!
They don't have a chance against Shiv!
This is like being frozen in ice without the trauma...
That man was quite large.
Help me stop the detective!
Nothing is working on Abrams!
Bebop, I really wish you'd stop trying to kill me.
I am not afraid of you, Bebop.
Bebop, you'll never intimidate me.
Stopped that marauding robot!
You have to try harder than that, Bebop!
I got your number, Bebop!
You can't beat me, Bebop!
How can so much anger fill up such a tiny man?
Billy. You need to relax and enjoy life!
Billy. Hating life won't get you very far.
That cat deserves better than you, Calico.
You couldn't run forever, Calico.
The Doorman has been handled.
I put an end to your tricks, Doorman.
No more reality-bending for you, my friend!
You won't prey on us, Drifter.
No more innocents will suffer at your hands!
A pity I couldn't stop him sooner.
Drifter got what he deserved.
I'm sorry, my friend, but I can't let you win.
I wish I didn't have to do that, professor.
If I never see a black hole again, it will be too soon.
Look out for the professor!
I'm sorry, Grey Talon. I don't have a choice.
There are other ways to seek justice, Talon.
I'm sorry for your loss, Talon, but... this isn't going to solve anything.
Glad I took her out before she killed us all.
If it makes you feel better, I got lucky.
You can't escape me, Haze!
You were never getting away, Haze!
Your intentions are noble, sheriff, but I can't let you win.
You came a long way to fail, sheriff.
We're all looking for answers, Holliday. Sadly, you won't be getting yours today.
That lasso was never going to get it done.
Ugh, such a good bartender, too!
See you at the bar later?
And here I thought your fire-starting days were behind you, Infernus.
Infernus, back to your old tricks, I see.
That... Could have gone bad.
Infernus. You didn't think that would work, did you?
I wish I was fighting alongside you, not against you.
I took out their support!
Ivy won't be helping her team for a while.
You're the monster, Geist, not Oathkeeper.
I won't be fed to your pet spirit, Geist.
That woman needs to be stopped!
I won't let that monster get what she wants!
Don't get close to Geist!
Geist is looking to steal your health!
Engage Geist from a distance.
Eh, I don't see what the big deal is.
Lash is out of commission.
That solves our little Lash problem.
Everyone needs to be humbled, Lash.
McGinnis, you deserve more than being a lackey for Maximilian.
You're no better than Calico, McGinnis.
I could never trade my morals for coin like that woman.
You're wasting your talents, McGinnis.
You made your choice when you signed with Fairfax Industries.
Your machines aren't getting it done, McGinnis!
I'll deal with McGinnis' little toys!
How many of these things does she have?!
She was so casually cruel.
You have much to learn, Mina.
Maybe you're not as invincible as you think you are, Mina.
She is precarious, to put it mildly.
I empathize with the Djinn, but their fight isn't my own!
You're a man of principles, Mirage, I respect that.
There's no shame in losing to me, Mirage.
You two are fun guys, Ha!.. Sorry about shooting you.
Nothing personal, Mo, it's just business.
They're a scrappy pair, aren't they?
That young lady has a bright future ahead of her, but... Today, she will be a failure.
The Book Lover's been defeated!
I hate to stifle such imagination.
Today we are enemies, but hopefully tomorrow... We should be allies.
I stopped the time thief.
Paradox is no longer a threat.
We need not worry about Paradox.
You're clever, Paradox, but you're not better than me.
You're not as smart as you think, Paradox.
I've been put in worse death traps.
You have to be faster if you want to catch me, Paradox!
This is not your day, Pocket.
This can't be the life you want for yourself, Pocket.
That encounter will haunt me...
Seven could only elude consequence for so long.
You're just a bully, Shiv. And I hate bullies...
Oh you want to pick on someone, Shiv? Pick on me!
You give the Baxter Society a bad name, Shiv.
It'll take more than knives to stop me.
Take your knife throwing act somewhere else!
I never thought I'd be at war with the Vatican!
Come, Venator, and learn that I'm not easy prey!
Your hunt will fail, Venator!
You'll have to try harder, Venator!
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Venator!
I was hoping us corpses could stick together.
I wish you good luck on your search, my friend, but... I can't let you win.
Sadly, my search for the truth has to trump your own.
If you wanted to be "glass half-full"... At least he's not in pain.
Your cause is just, Vindicta, but your methods...
I suppose now is probably a bad time to give a lecture on violence.
Vindicta's looking for us!
That was pretty impressive, no?
Go back to the Deep, Viscous. It's safer.
The surface is no place for a sea anemone.
That goo suit was only going to last for so long.
Regretting your choices yet, Viscous?
Vyper's an odd one, that's for sure.
She certainly has a... unique personality.
Alas, Vyper, I have not acquired a taste for your charm.
She won't be harassing us for a bit.
You're not the law, Warden. You're just a glorified bounty hunter.
Your goals are noble, Warden. Your tactics, eh, less so.
I won't back down from you, Warden.
I'll stand up to you, Warden, no matter the costs!
Take your vices somewhere else!
You're not in control here.
Don't have to worry about Wraith any more.
Put me down this instant!
I may not bleed, but... that doesn't mean I'm looking to get stabbed.
The Seventh Moon's time ends tonight!
A sword was never going to be enough.

name: Lady Geist
lines: My debt to Oathkeeper will be paid.
I will never be forgotten.
I paid a terrible price for a second chance. And I would gladly pay it again.
There's no turning back now.
Prepare yourself for what's to come.
Do you have the stomach to do what needs to be done?
I didn't sell my soul. I saved my life.
Beauty doesn't need to fade.
Oathkeeper doesn't need to be fed yet.
It's ok. I can control him a little longer.
I won't give in to Oathkeeper today.
I think you can handle this all on your own.
I wish I could help, but I have a gala to attend.
I won't suffer this quietly.
You're not seriously walking away from me, are you?
If you need me, I'll be at the Met.
Victory demands sacrifice.
My life... for their blood.
If I'm to win, I must be willing to use Oathkeeper to his fullest potential!
Blood is but one path to power.
I may bleed... but they will die.
You won't walk away from this.
I paid the price, now die!
I'm running out of options!
I'm flying close to the sun.
Drain Life's almost ready.
Life Drain is on cooldown.
The lives of the weak are meant to sustain the lives of the strong.
I'll syphon their spirit.
I will condemn my enemies.
No one's will is stronger than my own.
I'll drain their very essence.
Their lives will slip away.
I will watch them writhe.
The smart will run. The foolish will die.
Today I don't have the luxury of mercy!
Life can only be bought with life.
Your strength will be mine.
Your vitality belongs to me.
Just need to last a little longer!
Oathkeeper delights in suffering.
Pain is the price of victory.
They will be marked and they will die.
I spend life to take life.
My power comes at a cost.
My misery will be shared...
My essence will slice through them!
I'll show them the strength of my resolve.
I will suffer... But they will die.
This is just a taste of what's to come.
This is just the beginning.
It starts with a simple cut.
From here, only misery will follow.
Your death is inevitable.
Ready to steal their life force!
Their health will become mine!
When the time is right, I'll steal their health!
Their health will belong to me!
I will consume their essence!
Oathkeeper is ready to be fed!
Soul Exchange is on cooldown.
When the time is right, they will be brought low.
There is no reward without risk.
I will steal their victory.
Today, Oathkeeper receives his payment in spades.
Their life will sustain my own.
This can mean the difference between life, and death.
I'll lure them into my trap.
Life is nothing but a resource to be spent wisely.
You think you're winning?
You are not in control here!
Oathkeeper will get his payment!
You have no idea what I'm capable of.
Oathkeeper has been satisfied.
Your fate has been sealed.
You were a fool to challenge us.
Their death was inevitable.
What is money when compared to the power of Oathkeeper?
And they thought they could escape me.
This is one of many victories to come!
Together we will not fall.
This is only the beginning!
The blood will flow down Broadway.
You were fools to fight me!
Live at my behest... Die at my whim.
I walk the line between life and death.
What do I have to fear from ants?
I won't be killed by the likes of you.
I'll disrupt their healing.
I have more tricks up my emerald sleeve!
Bullets will not harm me!
Ready to steal their vitality!
Your powers mean nothing!
This should keep Oathkeeper happy.
Oathkeeper grows in power!
I must improve my powers.
I can buy better equipment.
I should revisit the store.
I wonder what I can afford?
It's probably time to buy something new.
The money won't help me in my pocket.
My next purchase could change the battle.
There's nothing I can't acquire.
I need to spend these souls.
You thought that would work?!
I shouldn't leave money lying around.
Well! What do we have here?
Blood money spends as good as any coin.
Ahhh, the fruits of my labour.
Let the mediocre fight for scraps.
Another objective has been claimed.
The ritual is one step closer.
Another part of the ritual complete.
When I find you, you will suffer.
They'll come back... and then they'll pay.
It takes someone better than that to kill me.
I know when it's time to leave a party.
No sense in throwing my life away!
It's dangerous to be alone out here!
An ambush could come from anywhere!
I remain... As I always shall.
And once again... I am alone.
It's important to know when to back away.
Now is not the time for valor.
And now we make their lives hell.
They have the Rejuvenator!
They've taken the Rejuvenator!
They will press the advantage, and we must be ready!
I won't leave my allies to die!
I can't waste any more time at the base!
You're on your own for now!
I think I can still make the opera.
I am perfection in all things!
Together, we were unbeatable!
My time has only just begun.
Oathkeeper has been sated.
I always get what I want.
Death will never find me!
At last the ritual is complete!
Finally, we've completed the ritual!
Now to receive our blessing from the Patron!
Let's see what I have to work with today.
You all make suitable pawns.
Not my choice for who I'd summon a god with, but the Patron wants what the Patron wants.
Soon I'll be free of you, Oathkeeper.
There is no cost I'm not willing to pay.
They will beg for mercy, and none will be given.
You were all surprisingly competent. Good job.
Yes, you were the help, but you were solid help.
I think we should celebrate!
Our lives are about to change for the better.
They can't stop you, Abrams!
Abrams is leading the charge!
Bebop's bringing them in.
Let the guardian deal with that one.
Bebop knocked them into position!
Maybe they'll run out of bullets shooting William.
They took out William with a regrettable goat head.
The professor made an opening!
Hopefully he doesn't have a heart attack before he gets there.
I guess the arthritis hasn't set in after all?
Perhaps I shouldn't have judged him carrying a bow after all.
Thank God for Grey Talon!
Talon certainly likes to cut it close.
I see Grey Talon has a flair for the dramatic.
I'll be with you soon, Haze.
That was impressive, Haze.
Your precision is impecable, Haze.
I'd hate to be fighting her.
Holliday did her part. Now we need to do ours.
They killed my bartender!
Thanks for your help, Fern.
Fern, you are wasting your talents behind a bar.
She's too chipper for me.
Thanks for your help, Ivy.
See, Ivy? We can work together.
Don't fail me this time, Kelvin.
Cutting it a little close, aren't we?
Thanks for having my back, Kelvin.
Yes, Lash... You're very impressive.
It's like he came out of nowhere.
They didn't see that coming.
I don't care how useful she is, she annoys me.
Thanks for the set-up, McGinnis.
Thanks for the help, McGinnis!
I knew I could count on you, McGinnis!
Ugh! I can still smell the mole.
Don't get yourself into trouble, child.
That woman delights in causing chaos!
Pocket is off to do... whatever an urchin does.
That man is a glorious monster...
Have fun out there, Shiv.
Nothing seems to stop him!
It's a pleasure watching you fight, Shiv.
They actually think they can stop Shiv? Adorable!
I'll be back when I can, Venator.
He looks more brooding than normal.
She doesn't miss, does she?
Well, this is a strange sensation.
Saved by a blob of goo. Hm.
Try not to die, Vyper. No one will miss you if you do.
He is looking focused today.
Warden's turning the tide!
Warden's taking them all on!
I'll help you soon, Wraith.
Thanks for holding them, Wraith.
That woman is impossible to have a conversation with.
You're relentless, Yamato!
You took the wrong case, Abrams.
Give me that Tome, Abrams!
The demon wasn't as strong as they thought they were.
And to think that, for a moment, I was worried.
Why won't this thing die?
What does it take to stop Abrams?!
The machine never had a chance.
Bebop was out of his depth.
The automaton's been destroyed.
Bebop is not a credible threat.
You didn't think that would stop me, did you?
You'll have to try harder than that, Bebop.
Bebop's looking to hook someone!
I took care of that ridiculous goat man.
Contrarians are so... exhausting.
I tire of your prattling, William.
Took out the arms dealer.
Ugh, she reeked of new money.
Calico won't be bothering us for a while.
If you were more pleasant, maybe I would have given you a tip.
The Baroness is a shell of its past glory.
The Doorman is no one we need to be concerned with.
The Help often have... Delusions of grandeur.
What do I have to fear from a doorman?
If you're going to be a mass murderer, at least have some decorum.
You're not freeing Oathkeeper, Drifter.
And he thought I'd be easy prey.
I'm not afraid of you, Drifter.
Stick to the classroom, professor.
You'll never get your body back.
You're never completing the ritual, Dynamo.
Look out for that black hole!
I remember when he was handsome.
Be grateful you lived this long, Grey Talon.
The Archer has been handled.
I was hoping cholesterol would have done the work for me, but oh well.
Look out for the damn owl!
The government needs to stay out of my business.
Oathkeeper is not the OSIC's concern, Haze!
Perhaps Haze should have taken me more seriously.
The Sandman posed little threat.
There's no running from me, Haze.
You think I can't see you, Haze?
The assassin's over here!
Your investigations have come to an end.
You traveled a long way just to die here.
New York isn't for you, my dear.
I'm sure you're somebody important in whatever irrelevant farm town you call "home."
We'll finish this later, Sheriff.
She can't keep bouncing forever!
You can't outrun the inevitable!
Ugh, he was the only one who knew how to make a proper Gin and Tonic. Pity.
At least I don't have to tip him anymore.
Infernus is no longer a problem.
Stick behind the bar, darling. It's safer.
It's nothing personal, Infernus.
Sorry, Fern. I'll give you a nice tip tomorrow.
I can't have you stopping me, Infernus!
I took out their support.
Ivy, Ivy, Ivy, when will you learn?
You're a glorified garden statue, know your place.
Stick to Spanish Harlem. Here, there are real monsters about.
That one's tough to kill.
That's for squandering my investment!
Your time has passed, Kelvin.
Consider this the official removal of my funding.
How dare you oppose me, Kelvin!
Fighting for them?! After everything I have done for you?!
You can't run from me, Kelvin.
There's no escaping me, Kelvin.
I won't be bullied by a stevedore.
The moustache is all that's impressive about you, Lash.
Lash was all talk. Surprise, surprise.
How could anyone idolize someone so crass?
Poor, predictable Lash...
For a moment, you almost looked heroic, Lash.
I could use someone with your intellect, McGinnis.
McGinnis, we've had amicable dealings before. Why throw your life away now?
I thought you were smarter than crossing me.
Looks like Fairfax Industries needs a new engineer.
This is what happens when you fight your betters, McGinnis.
Took out one of her turrets!
Another turret's been dealt with!
You need to pick better friends, Mina.
You're surrounding yourself with deplorable people, Mina.
She has my ambition... But not my talent, I'm afraid.
I stopped the vampire girl.
At least he was a gentleman.
Mirage isn't a threat anymore.
Wretched little creature.
Those two are insufferable.
I'll be washing the stench off me for weeks.
Killed the oversized rat!
She was young and foolish.
I bet Johann would like her.
Darling... This isn't the place for you.
You were a fool to oppose me.
She won't be shielding her friends for a while.
First my husband, now me. When will Paradox stay out of my life?
I've looked forward to this for quite some time.
You thought you were untouchable, didn't you, Paradox?
I've waited fifty years for this.
Your organization will crumble.
She thought she was so clever...
Your tricks weren't enough.
You didn't really think that would work, did you?
That little thief did it again.
Right from under our noses!
Back to the gutter with you, Pocket!
Pocket is no threat to us!
You're a monster, Seven, and you got what you deserved.
You could only escape justice for so long, Seven.
I won't be another of your victims, Seven.
I'm lucky I survived that.
Your machinations end here.
Take cover from the storm!
He was a handsome one, too!
Perhaps you should have taken me more seriously, Shiv.
You'll learn to respect your betters, Shiv.
I hate destroying beautiful things... oh well!
I need help killing Shiv!
You made a mistake coming here, Venator.
It's time for you to leave New York, Venator.
Your hunt has ended, Venator.
His is a life hardly worth stealing.
Go away, Victor. You're boring.
Please, like you're the first person who's tried to assassinate me.
Vindicta's trying to pick us off!
You weren't untouchable, Vindicta.
And she thought she was safe.
Hope she learned her lesson.
I won't be defeated by a pile of goo!
I wonder if I could scoop some of him up for a moisturizer.
They won't be hiding in the cube any longer.
There's that pile of goo.
You're not mugging me, Vyper.
Stay away from me, Vyper.
Bleed in a gutter where you belong, Vyper.
That cretin belongs in jail. Or the morgue.
Warden has been dealt with.
The man fights like he's possessed!
I tire of your heroics, Warden.
Don't get close to Warden.
New money is... so predictable.
You'll never be accepted in polite society, Wraith.
I expected more from you, Wraith.
You made a foolish mistake, Wraith.
Sorry, I hate card tricks.
What's the meaning of this?!
Yamato is no longer a concern.
Yes, yes, oh, you are incredibly threatening.
You have no idea what you're dealing with, Yamato.
We won't be bothered by Yamato for a while.
Don't get close to Yamato!

name: Lash
lines: When I come for you, you're gonna know it. There's just not a damn thing that you can do about it.
You were looking to summon a god, right? Well, here I am.
Ohh, I'll summon the Patrons. But just so I can tell 'em... "you're welcome".
Reason 26 I'm better than Bebop: Only one of us has an impossibly dashing mustache.
Reason number 87 I'm better than Bebop: He's Bebop.
See, not everyone can handle the weight of being the best fighter on God's green Earth.
The only demons I can't punch... are my own.
Fear... is for lesser men. And Bebop.
Oh, I'll summon the Patrons. And when I do, I know exactly what I'm wishing for.
Okay. Yeah, that was smart, don't pick me. Haha. See what happens.
Honestly, I was only planning on doing this as a favor to you, so- Ahah. Yeah, no worries.
I understand, you wanna feel a challenge. See what it's like to not be the god of combat.
Oh, Bebop got in your head, didn't he?
Not surprising. It takes time to get comfortable with greatness.
You don't need to be intimidated by me, I am quite approachable.
Ooh, down strike's almost ready!
Ground strike's on cooldown!
Divekicks are the new uppercut.
Winning isn't enough, you gotta do it with panache.
I can't wait to send them airborne!
So here's how this works: I fly in, fwoosh - boom! Then I kick 'em in the face.
Yeah, I can do it on the ground, but it's like a hundred-billion times cooler when I do it mid-air!
They're about to learn that their arms are too short to box with god.
I could start a fight with this, I can end a fight with this. I mean, it's basically the caviar of murder techniques.
I'm about to show you why I'm the best.
Tired of gettin' your ass kicked?
Who said that we were done?
The fight ends when I say it ends.
Oh, you think you got me beat?
I'll be the one walking away!
I'm puttin' you in the dirt.
They can try to run. It's not gonna work out well for 'em, but they can try.
Oh, I'm gonna crater 'em.
It's my bread and butter, baby!
Every time I hear someone scream in frustration, I just get a big ol' smile on my face!
I'm gonna be bouncin' all around that battlefield.
I can come at them from anywhere.
They won't see me comin', but boy, will they know I"ve been there.
Every time they think they're safe, I'll be ready to fly in and finish the job.
Is flyin' in on someone trying to escape a dick move? Sure, but I'm alive and they're dead, so who cares?
I'm about to ruin your day.
Ahh, Flog's almost ready!
I gotta keep the dance goin'!
Crowd doesn't like it when I kill 'em too quick. This helps me keep it interesting.
Perfect cardio, perfect form, perfect hair.
If they think they can stand toe to toe with me, they are going to have a beautifully bad day.
Practical and recreational.
I'll whip 'em into shape.
If I'm gonna be up close, I need to be ready.
I am ready to get my hands dirty.
Well, let's go ruin their lives!
I'm going to destroy them with this.
They're not gonna know what hit 'em.
Time to show 'em I'm not messin' around.
Awh, I'm gonna make this look good.
Time to put down some rivals.
Don't you get it? I'm playing with you.
You gonna run? Or do you want me to slap you around some more?
You're not taking me down.
I got a little somethin' for everybody.
We're not losing to them!
You think you've got the best of me?
They are just begging to get killed by me.
Need a second wind, come on!
Just need to hang on a little longer!
Ready to pick up and slam 'em down!
Ready to pick someone off!
Death Slam is good to go!
Say the word and I will Death Slam the shit out of them!
Who's ready to see me be amazing?
I'll slam 'em down, you guys take 'em out!
Are you ready to watch perfection in action?
The only thing they'll be able to do is watch in horror. Heh.
They get too close, they'll regret it.
Now this is how you finish a fight.
If they're not dead after this, they won't be alive much longer.
Time to play catch with some inferior fighters.
I don't just end fights, I do it with style.
There's nothing like making someone feel helpless.
They'll know it's over before I even land the final blow - fwoo psshh!
You can give up whenever you want.
Alright, I'm done playin' with you.
You don't got what it takes.
Ooh, they'll be crying about that one.
Don't you get it? You're outmatched.
They actually thought they had a chance.
It was over the moment they decided to fight us.
Eh, they won't be the last person I take out.
One more for the collection.
Well, don't need a gun to take out someone like you.
All that power and you didn't even know how to use it.
You thought you were on a roll, didn't you?
You make a decent sidekick.
Let me show y'all how it's done.
I don't know about you guys, but I'm not stoppin' any time soon!
This is just the beginning.
What, you think you hate me now? Just wait until I kill you again!
Winning's my business, and business is - wa-ching! - good!
Don't feel so bad. The world's full of mediocre talent.
It's cool, everyone. Gettin' killed by me is an honor.
Don't look so surprised! I-I'm better than all of you.
You wanna play? Let's play.
Let's see ya stop me now!
Oh, they are really about to hate me!
That should make the damage stick!
This should slow their healing!
I'm not worried about bullets.
What ya gonna do? Shoot me?
I got more where that came from.
I'm ready to make the big play.
Time to shoot magic in the face.
Oh, I'll end their magic.
You think you can stop me?
I can train my abilities.
Ready to get stronger... just need to find a place to train.
I should find a place to train up.
I can use these souls at the shop.
Might wanna spend these souls.
I should check out what I can buy at the shop.
I wonder what they have at the shop?
I gotta remember to check out that store.
I should go back and spend.
I can get a quality relic!
Worth seein' what I can afford.
There's nothin' I can't buy.
That's not gonna happen on my watch.
People just love leaving me gifts.
One step closer to completing the ritual.
We took another objective.
Ahhh, victory keeps getting closer.
That should impress the Patron.
How long you think you can hide from me?
Quit wasting my time, and come out and fight!
Your luck's gonna run out eventually.
When my life just flashed before my eyes, I realized that, I - I - I'm even more amazing than I remembered!
You're just not good enough to hit me.
Close, but not close enough.
Keep tryin'! Maybe you'll get lucky.
They could be hiding anywhere!
I can't afford to get caught off guard.
Relax, it's all good. I'm used to high-pressure situations.
Wouldn't have it any other way.
They saved the best for last!
I'm good, but I'm not stupid.
Ugh, I'm outnumbered. I need to be careful.
Got the Rejuvenator! You're welcome.
They got the Rejuvenator!
Oh, they got the Rejuv? Well that just means we get to beat 'em twice.
They picked up the Rejuv.
Guess it's time for me to do my thing.
Gotta give my adoring public what they want!
Time to make a grand entrance.
Can't keep my adoring fans waiting.
Don't waste your bullets!
Bullets aren't gonna hurt 'em!
What are you waiting for?!
God, I love being the best!
I hope you're all ready to watch the god of combat do his thing.
You don't need to summon the Patrons to have your wish granted: I'm already here.
There's no world we don't win, unless you guys screw it up.
Alright people, let's go crush some dreams.
You guys are about to bear witness to God's gift to combat.
You just watched a master at work.
I hope you all enjoyed sitting underneath the learning tree.
Ah-ah! No need to thank me. Being amazing is a burden I'm willing to bear.
Hold on to that memory, boys and girls.
Don't die before I can kill you, Bebop!
They took out Bebop!.. I'm cool with it.
They took out Bebop! Aww, no surprise there!
Bebop?.. Urgh, I can heal you.
They took out the sheriff.
They killed the bartender.
They took out the gargoyle!
Give 'em hell, glowstick!
Pop some heads, Vindicta!
You go, you beautiful ball of goo!
Ugh, I-I'm with you, Vyper!
There goes one scary son of a bitch...
Took down their big boy. Boom!
"Bluey", has got himself a case of the dead.
Bebop, Bebop, Bebop. You dumb bastard.
Hey Bebop! Pro tip: stop sucking.
Sun is shining. Bebop's dead. I'm about to summon an elder god. Boom.
Oh! This reminds me of the time I beat the tar out of Bebop.
I hope you enjoyed that, Bebop, because you're going to be experiencing that again and again.
Let's blow the shit outta Bebop.
Oh? Oh, check out what Bebop brought!
Calico's down and nobody misses her.
Guess I have to clean up the Baxter Society's mess.
Should've stuck to grading papers, professor!
This is why I never bothered with college!
Took out Dynamo. No big deal. You're welcome.
Time passed you by, Grey Talon!
Beating up old people is surprisingly rewarding.
Oh, I'm sorry, why am I supposed to be scared of you again?
Well, well, well. Looky who just picked a fight with the sandman.
I'm assuming this where the feds come and offer me your job.
I thought you were supposed to be some kind of badass assassin. What happened?
Holiday's over!.. ugh, God, I've gotta workshop that one more.
She won't be back anytime soon.
You make a better bartender than you do a fighter.
Infernus is out of commission.
You'll never be fast enough, Infernus.
Love that you hate Mendoza. Hate that you picked a fight with me.
Come at me again, same shit's gonna happen.
It's nothing personal, Ivy.
Welp, this is what happens when you fight the best.
Had a good plan, Kelvin. Shame you couldn't execute it.
I'm not getting trapped by you, Kelvin.
Geist, your luck has just run out.
Anddd I took out Lady Geist.
Only one person sucks out peoples' will to live and you're looking at him.
McGinnis, when ya gonna learn?
If Bebop can't stop me, your little wind up toys aren't getting it done.
Too bad, McG! You just don't got what it takes.
Well, look who failed the Djinn!
Looks like Ambassador Nashala is gonna need a new bodyguard.
You're not on my level, Mirage!
The Djinn picked the wrong guy to protect them.
Alright, which one is Mo and which one is Krill? Just kidding, I don't care.
That mole man looked pissed!
She went to college!.. I mean, it didn't help her win a fight, but what an accomplishment.
You seem nice. You know what? When this is over, I'll teach you how to not lose a fight.
Took down little miss fishbowl head.
Yeah, Paradox won't be bothering us for a while.
I don't get the big deal.
Come back when you hit puberty!
Pocket, this isn't the life for you.
Just took down public enemy #1. You are welcome.
I don't get what the OSIC's problem is. Stopping Seven was easy!
Ooh, I'm not getting killed by an oversized Halloween decoration!
Seven, stop acting like you're better than everyone. No one likes an egomaniac.
There's only room for one impossibly handsome asshole.
The Baxter Society will let anyone in these days, huh?
When ya gonna learn, Shiv?
And you thought you were in pain before, Victor.
By the time I'm through with him, he's gonna have to find himself a new face.
Come on, Victor, get up so I can do that again.
You made me work for it, Vindicta. I'll give you that.
Killing ghosts and breaking hearts.
Vindicta's been dealt with.
You picked the wrong fight, Vindicta.
Where do you think you're flying off to?
You're about to be grounded, lady.
Better luck next time, goo boy.
How about you go slide back to where you came from?
That's, uh... that was... that was a lot of goo.
Maybe now she'll stop sending me mail.
Some fans take it a little too far.
Oh, I hope she got the message...
I need her to leave me alone!
Can we please take out Vyper?
If you wanted to win, you never should've picked the other side, Warden.
I don't wanna know what kind of swinger party that guy was going to.
He thought he was a tough guy.
There's always someone looking to pick a fight they can't win.
Backed the wrong horse, Wraith. Uh, like always.
It's a shame it had to go down like this, Wraith
Wraith, you can have eight arms and you couldn't stop me.
You see that? Not even Wraith can take me out.
That's the best the Seventh Moon's got?
You can't buy me, Yamato.
Oh, that sword is gonna look so good over my fireplace!

name: McGinnis
lines: Do I love working for Fairfax Industries? No. Does it pay a small fortune? Yes. How do I sleep at night? Like a baby.
What's the point of building toys if you never get to use 'em?
Ready to do some field testing.
Ethics are for scientists that can't think big enough.
So, you need an engineer, huh?
Looks like it's back to the machine shop.
I gotta go back to the lab anyway.
Great. I thought of a new way to weaponize souls in the shower, I need to go to the lab.
You wanna try to win without me? Be my guest.
Wish I could help, this deadline is killing me.
Sorry, the boys in the shop need my help.
Weapons testing is gonna have to wait.
You don't want me to get shot at today? Don't have to tell me twice. Go pick Kevin- Kelvin... w-whatever his name is.
There'll be plenty of time for gray area weapons testing later.
Let's work on those turrets.
Think I'll let these things do the shooting for me.
The more turrets, the better.
I need to make as many of these as I can.
Hm, more turrets never hurt!
Can't go wrong with these!
Let's get some more turrets on the field.
I'll lay a trap for those bastards.
Time to build some firepower.
Gotta build me some backup.
Alright buddy, give 'em hell!
Gotta get as many of these up as I can.
Gotta build these faster...
This needs to come online quick.
Please don't malfunction.
Gotta stock up on those medical supplies.
Gotta keep everyone up and fighting.
How hard can being a medic be?
The longer we stay on the field, the better.
I can patch up a bullet hole or two.
I gotta look after my crew.
Look, if I can patch a wall, I can patch a bullet hole.
No one's dying on my watch.
We're staying in this fight.
If they wanna put us down, they're gonna have to work for it.
We're staying in this fight!
Alright, let's take a look at those wounds.
Who needs to be patched up?
Come on, come on, come on!
I... know a thing or two about building walls.
Time to reshape the battlefield.
Use this right, people will love me. Use it wrong, well... my team will be dead, so it's not like anyone will complain.
My team's gonna love me. The other guys... ehh...
Who doesn't love dropping a wall on someone?
Ah, I love the versatility of this thing.
This thing can solve sooo many problems.
They think they hate fighting me now?
If this misfires, my team won't let me hear the end of it.
I'll be able to cut off their escape.
Don't let them out-position us!
Might be my last chance...
Spectral Barrage is ready!
Ready to fire some spirits!
These spirits aren't gonna fire themselves.
Who's ready to blow some stuff up?!
I can't wait to launch these babies!

Pleasure workin' with ya!
Get used to it: this is gonna be happening all night.

God, that took a lot of ammo.

name: Mina
lines: I hope I get to work with Lady Geist. She's an icon!
It was either do this or go to a lame vampire salon, and let me tell you, I do not plan on putting up with 6 hours of harpsichord music.
The elders can keep the old world. New York is going to be my playground.
I'm tired of being at the bottom of the vampiric social ladder.
Time to shake up the vampiric hierarchy.
This city could use some new blood.
Summoning the Patrons never looked this good.
You have excellent taste.
Soon, I'll be Viscount of New York.
I'm not hanging out with those losers.
I have a fashion empire to build.

Sorry, I'm working on my look-book.
