Go get Vyper to help you, she'll probably do it for a trip to the laundromat. You know, assuming she's not in jail.
Oh, I'm flattered, but I'm not interested in associating with some of those people.
If they get close, they'll regret it.
This should keep the rabble away.
Eh, they'll die, I'll live, it'll be fine.
I'm not worried about my health.
If I want their blood, I'll take it.
They're going to regret getting close to me.
I hope I don't bend my umbrella beating them to death.

Can you just die, please?

They die, when I say they die.
I'm going to kill them all.
I'm coming for every one of them!
I have to be sure to spread this around.
The beginning of the end.
More bats for the collection!
I can’t wait for the grand finale!
I’d give up if I were you.

My bats will fill the air!
They're gonna be running like hell!
Chase them down, darlings.
My bats will run them down.
Who's ready to see something amazing?
Nox Nostra's almost ready.
Nox Nostra's on cooldown.
They have no idea what's in store for them.
The umbrella's not just for show!
You ready to stretch your wings, darlings?
I can't wait to hear their wings flutter!
This just keeps getting better and better!
The sky will be filled with crimson!
Looking forward to hearing them scream!
It starts slow, but boy, does it ramp up!
This is going to be spectacular!
There's no hope for them.
I love hunting in the city!
Manhattan is my feeding grounds!
You have no idea what I’m capable of!
Run for your pitiful lives!
You missed your chance to kill me!
I won! Big surprise there.
No one stops me from getting what I want.
Don't bother fighting back.

Great. Now I'm gonna have to get this dry-cleaned.

I get why Sandra thinks he's hot.
I was expecting more from you, Lash.
I'm not some grubby pit fighter, Lash, I'm real talent!

Oh, a bad boy. How original.
He thought he was so cool, didn't he?
Ugh, get with the times, Shiv! Stabbing people was sooo three years ago.
I hate your stupid pompadour!
Magic tricks are stupid, and I'm glad you're dead.

I won't be hunted by the likes of you!
Leave the Vampire Nation alone!

He looked so sad... Oh well, who cares?
I hate killing a man who can pull off leather pants.
So, now that you know you're gonna lose, do you think your name's ironic or just tragic?
What lame costume party did she walk out of?
That girl needs some shoes.
Annnd Vindicta died again.
You tried to assassinate me? Who'd I look like, Arin Fairfax?
You don't have what it takes to stop me, Vindicta.
You thought you were safe in the skies?
Get with the times, Vindicta!
I can get to you whenever I want, Vindicta!
Oh my god... He was made of goo.
He's like if salt water taffy grew arms and legs.
That goo better not stain my jacket!
Oh, my God, you are the most disgusting woman I've ever met.
I cannot kill that woman fast enough.
What a wretched little creature.
I loathe everything about you, Vyper.
I hate your stupid face, I hate your stupid attitude, and I hate your stupid Midwest accent!
I've seen Vampire Elders with a smaller stick up their ass.
That guy's gotta work through some mommy and daddy issues.
Yeah, I don't get why people are scared of him.
Uh, course I killed Warden! I'm me.
Warden's making his move!
Yeah, she has money, but it's new money, so it's like... Eh.
Credit where credit is due: her hat was pretty great.
You shouldn't try to rise above your station, Wraith.
Some queen bee she turned out to be.
Looks like she was all hype.
Who would have guessed the woman swinging an antique didn't survive?
Step into the 20th century, honey.
Yamato's dead, which isn't surprising, cuz she was fighting me.
I don't get why people are scared of her.
You lost, Yamato. Deal with it!
Don't get close to Yamato!

I'll travel the city on my terms.
Nashala will take me where I need to go.
No one will be denied my aid.
Take me where I'm needed.

I move at your whims, Nashala.
The Djinn take me where I'm needed.
Time for a change of environs.
I need to get out of here.

One less threat to worry about.

They knew they were outmatched.
Run, while you still can!
The Djinn have blessed me today.
It will be easy to find myself over my head.
The enemy could be anywhere.
I remain--and I will surive.
The stakes are higher than ever.
I can't afford to fail now.
There are too many of them.
Now is the time to make a move.
Well done securing the Rejuvenator.
They have the Rejuvenator!
They got the Rejuvenator! We can't afford to be careless!
I can't let my team fight without me!
It's time to complete the ritual.
This is our moment of triumph!
They're immune to bullets!
The undisciplined will never beat me.
I hope after the ritual I have time to do some sightseeing.
I won't fail you, Nashala. The Patron will be summoned.
It's time to enact the ritual.
Summoning the Patrons will be no small task.
They'll try to stop us, and they will fail.
Soon, the Djinn will have a place to call their own.
We have ushered in a new age.
I am indebted to you all.
The Djinn will not forget your aid.
The detective is a juggernaut.
That man fights with courage.
The scrap golem was clever.
They killed the professor!
The professor trapped them!
I'm in your debt, professor.
Haze, I'll join you when I can.
Holliday's looking determined.
I'll follow in the sheriff's footsteps.
Why, thank you, Holliday.
Kelvin will be able to hold his own.
Thanks for trapping them.
Appreciate your help, McGinnis.
I'll remember this kindness, McGinnis.
Thank you for looking after us.
McGinnis really came through.
The moles of New York are larger than expected.
Do I still have my wallet?
Paradox moved them into position.
She took the Rejuv from under them.
Glad Paradox is working for us.
Paradox played her part well.
Be with you when I can, Pocket.
Hope Shiv knows what he's doing.
I'll go rabbit hunting later.
May the Djinn guide your aim.
May your blade find every target.
The detective is no longer a threat.
Abrams has been neutralized.
He had conviction that rivaled my own.
I take no joy in this, Bebop.
He had passion, but passion only goes so far.
The scrap golem made questionable choices.
Perhaps you chose a poor time to stand still.
You made this rather easy for me, Bebop.
Anger is a fruitless pursuit, Billy.
Billy, you're impressively ignorant.
New Yorkers are stranger than I expected.
I hope that mind finds peace one day.
I won't be stopped by you, Cailco.
You brought so much suffering to the world, Calico. You got what you deserved.
Never trust someone who owns a sphynx.
Until today, our stay at the Baroness has been rather pleasant.
He seemed much nicer when he was handling Nashala's bags.
Nashala will be disappointed that we need to check out of the Baroness.
The Doorman has been defeated.
Perhaps I should have read the reviews of the Baroness before checking in.
I will always make time to stop men like you.
The innocent of New York are safe.
The Drifter died at my hand.
No mercy will be given to the likes of you.
I haven't felt evil like that in some time.
I took down the professor.
Your wife will mourn you.
Brilliance only gets you so far.
He seemed like a kind man.
The battlefield is no place for a teacher.
Dynamo is making his move.
Here comes the professor.
Look out for the black hole.
Rest well, Mr. Grey Talon.
A warrior. To the bitter end.
He got the death he wanted.
He knew how this would end.
It would appear that I am now at odds with the OSIC.
The OSIC needs to stay out of my way.
The Djinn deserve a home, Haze.
The question remains-- was she acting alone or under orders?
That could have gone poorly.
You have lost your sense of justice, Holliday.
You are no servant of the law... Just an instrument of rage.
Holliday's been dealt with.
The sheriff flees from consequences.
It would seem the sheriff is a coward.
She knew what would happen if she stayed.
With all your wisdom, you still decided to fight me?
We have nothing to fear from Infernus.
The flame has been snuffed out.
Ivy, you need better friends.
You seem like a sweet person, Ivy. You deserve better than this.
Ivy is out of commission.
Kelvin won't be supporting his team for a while.
A courageous, albeit futile, attempt.
I may be Nashala's servant but you are the Oathkeeper's slave.
The might of the Oathkeeper is nothing before the power of the Djinn.
New York is a safer place with her dead.
I hope his ego never heals.
Maybe a little humility will do him good.
You're not half as impressive as you think you are, Lash.
Ms. McGinnis, your time in the sun has passed.
I smashed her tools of war.
McGinnis is no longer a threat.
Ingenuity alone was never gonna be enough to stop me.
Fairfax Industries have failed to impress.
Her machines will not save them.
She will plant more of these, and I will be ready.
I wonder how many more of these I'll have to destroy?
Mina, your childish antics won't stop me.
One day you'll grow up and realize your folly.
You won't feed on me today, vampire.
That was an unusually large mole.
I thought New York was supposed to have a rat problem?
Forgive me for what I must do.
She seemed like a kind soul, why would she align with them?
A pity... Nashala would find her amusing.
My convictions will be tested today.
Nashala won't end up in one of your museums, Paradox.
Paradox will be destroyed.
The Djinn won't rest until Paradox is dismantled.
The Djinn's enemies are my enemies.
You're not as smart as you think.
All you did was delay the inevitable.
Really, Paradox? That's the best you can do?
She stole the Rejuvenator.
Paradox stole our Rejuvenator!
Pocket has been dealt with.
You have noble aims, Pocket, but today is not your day.
You are out of your depth, Pocket.
I'm not afraid of you, Seven.
Men like you have no place in this world.
You've evaded death for the last time.
You were destined to fail, Seven.
Shiv is no longer a threat.
You won't be stabbing anyone, Shiv.
Perhaps, in time, he'll become a threat.
I expected more from the Baxter society.
You two need to work something out.
Divided, they have no chance against me.
A shame. They put on a good show.
You picked the wrong prey, Venator.
The Djinn will be protected from the likes of you.
One day, you will find what you seek, Victor.
I'm sorry that your answers will not be found today.
Good luck in your search, Victor.
You won't use me for target practice.
You're not the one who decides who lives or dies, Vindicta.
You're not picking off my team.
The Djinn have no quarrel with the Deep but I must do what I must.
New York is more odd than I anticipated.
I imagine Nashala would find him rather endearing.
There's that pile of goo.
I tire of your prattling.
She should've called herself "Weasel."
Warden is no longer a threat.
If only your ability matched your conviction.
Blind devotion isn't loyalty, it's ignorance.
Your obsession with the Patrons ends today.
The path of vices leads only to a dead end.
Her arrogance finally caught up with her.
Greed is not a cause worth dying for.
I don't fear the Seventh Moon.
I won't be bullied by the likes of you.
Yamato, your cruelty has brought you the end that you deserve.

name: Mo & Krill
lines: It's not the rats in New York they should worry about.
He does the digging, I do the talking. We tried it the other way but, it didn't work.
I got the gun, he's got the claws.
Don't mind the big guy, he's friendly. Unless, of course, you tried to stop us, in which case he would definitely maul you.
So, you need a couple Tunnel Rats, huh?
Guess you don't need us after all.
You're going to wish you had the Tunnel Rats on your side.
You sure about that? You get two for the price of one.
Come on, put us in the fight!
You obviously don't appreciate the value of a good mole person.
Alas, duty calls. And by "duty" I mean crime.
It's fine, we needed a day off!
We'll get in there and give 'em hell.
We never back down from a fight!
We'll be the last ones standing!
We'll turn their numbers against them.
We need to keep the pressure on them.
We aren't afraid to get up close.
They can try to outnumber us, but it won't go well for them.
The more of them, the better!
We don't back down from anyone!
We can't give 'em a break!
Death won't find us today.
Ready to do some digging.
They won't see us coming.
Won't lie, this always weirds me out.
We got to be smart how we come at them.
Hard to get shot at when you're underground.
Sand Blast's on cooldown!
Some people say it's fighting dirty, I say it's fighting to survive.
There's a fine line between fighting smart and fighting dirty.
Ha, they're not hitting us!
Hard to fight when there's sand in your eyes, haha!
Who cares if it's not fair, it works!
I'm not afraid to take shortcuts.
I'll take any advantage I can get.
This can create the opening we need.
I'll do whatever it takes to win.
You think you got the edge?
Time to make some new friends.
When I grab them, be ready.
I'll pull one of them out of the fight.
Ready to see what a mole man can do?
They'll be helpless soon enough.
I hope we find someone walking alone!
We're ready for the next team fight!
Almost ready to grab them.
The two of us can take down anyone!
Everyone has a plan until they're grabbed by a mole man.
I'll be ready to lock 'em down.
If there's any stragglers, we'll pick 'em off.
I can't hold them for long!
You messed with the wrong team.
We still have some fight left in us!
We just gotta keep doing that!
What sort of idiot gets in a fist fight with a mole person?!
Glad we put a stop to that.
We keep this up, they won't have a chance in hell.
We need to keep the advantage!
These people wouldn't last two hours in the tunnels!
I can't believe we were nervous about fighting these people.
No one is better than us!
If you're looking for mercy, my friends, I'm afraid it's in short supply.
They have no chance at stopping us!
You know, there's no shame in just giving up.
They're not going to like what happens next!
That should slow their healing.
Let's see them try to heal now!
We're not worried about getting shot!
Ready to grab another one.
No one will see us coming.
I'll deal with their magic!
They won't be able to use their powers!
We're not afraid of magic!
We can train our abilities.
Time for a little self-improvement.
Let's find a safe place to train.
Can't forget to check out the store.
We can afford better gear.
Wonder what we can buy now.
I'm sure there's something worth spending our money on.
I can afford a powerful relic!
We might want to spend what we've saved.
We can put these souls to good use.
No point in saving any more souls.
I think it's time we go shopping!
I can't wait to see what the shop has in store.
This might be our lucky day.
Who left this lying here?
If they're going to drop it, we're going to pick it up.
Well, well, well... Someone dropped their souls.
Far be from me to let this go to waste.
We're closer to completing the ritual.
Look at them: scrambling to find a silver lining!
We got the real prize. Let them take some scraps.
Another part of the ritual complete!
The objective's down. That's all that matters.
Why delay the inevitable? Just come out and die.
You can't hide from us forever.
They won't be so lucky next time!
We need to get out of here!
It takes more than that to kill us!
If things go bad, we need an exit strategy.
Looks like we're the only ones still standing.
I can't help but notice all our new friends are dead.
We might want to turn back.
Maybe we should think about, uh... digging a tunnel?
They stole the Rejuvenator!
We need to regroup, they have the Rejuvenator!
The time has come to complete the ritual.
The ritual will be over soon.
Now, let's go summon a Patron!
Don't waste your bullets!
Ah, they have metal skin!
Can't shoot through that.
You're on your own for now.
We'll be back when we can!
We should find a place to rest up.
Mole man, coming through!
I don't expect any of you are familiar with Mole-Man etiquette.
Realistically, this is seven on six so, haha, I like our chances.
Shenanigans are about to abound!
Tonight, we toast to victory!
Another job done to perfection!
And now we receive what we so richly deserve!
We could not have done this without all of your help.
We won! Because we work together, as a team.
They killed the blue guy!
That is a very scary man!
Abrams has them on the run!
They can't stop you, Abrams!
Now, let's go finish them off!
You're doing great, professor!
That was looking rough for a minute.
I'll be back soon, Talon!

So that's what a sandman does.
Good lord, that was a lot of bullets!
Haze, your timing is impeccable!
Infernus, don't you die on me!

Wow. That didn't take long.
Infernus, your misspent youth is being put to good use!
Thanks for the support, Ivy!
Ivy? I love working with you.
Now there goes a man with gusto!
I knew I could count on you, Kelvin.
Thanks for keeping us in the fight.
I'll be back when I can, Geist!
Geist is still in the fight!
Good God, that woman is horrifying!
Have fun, you magnificent bastard!
Well, at least he's as good as he thinks he is.
They never saw that coming!
Fair? No. Effective? Without question.
Hold the line until I'm back, McGinnis!
One of the few times I'm happy to see a wall.
Thanks for taking care of us, McGinnis.
We were getting worried for a minute.
Good thing you were here, McGinnis!
I won't leave you alone for long, Mirage.
Paradox puts them right where she wants them.
Please be careful, Pocket.
That laugh will haunt me!
I'm glad he's on our side.
I love watching that knife-wielding Lothario work!
Shiv fights like a man possessed!
Whew! Where did you learn to shoot like that?
I think I just saw a pilgrim take someone's head off.
Be careful, my gooey friend!
This is the best sewer sludge I've ever bathed in.
Warden is terrifying to behold!
Thank God Warden is on our side.
He certainly has... gusto.
Don't be reckless, Wraith.
Thanks for the help, Wraith!
They did not have a chance in hell!
The dead don't get to opine on what was or wasn't fair!
May your sword strike true!
Oho, they thought they were getting away, didn't they?
That was a big boy, wasn't it?
Abrams won't be bothering us for a while.
Why won't the detective die?!
And he thought he was better than us.

The arrogance that radiated off that boy was astounding!
Blackmore Academy: the breeding ground for Manhattan's finest narcissists.
Lash would have at least put up a fight.
You won't be hooking anyone for a while.
Bebop never had a chance.
You're making this too easy!
Billy, you need to stop being angry at the world, and start living for something!

I'm sure Billy will be whining about us in no time.

We probably should stay away from Coney for a while.
You will be missed, my dear.

You're a monster, Drifter.
We won't let you prey on the people of New York.
The Drifter has been stopped.
That man had no remorse, no humanity.
We didn't stop the Drifter, we only slowed him down...
Nothing personal, Dynamo.
Look out for the black hole!
The poor girl didn't even realize she was being used.
Let this be a lesson on the dangers of obeying a lich hand.
My dear, it's not safe to hang around with liches.
Your hunt is over, Grey Talon.
We won't be Talon's prey!
You should have stayed in retirement, my friend.
She didn't have enough bullets to take us out.
Oh dear, I think she was a fed.
She really thought she could hide from us?

You're not as clever as you thought, Haze.

Better luck next time, Holliday!
Of course she bounces away!
I like my fur unburned, thank you very much.
Mmm, he made good drinks, too.
Stick to pouring manhattans, friend.
Aw, no no no no no no naw...
You're a long way from Spanish Harlem, Ivy.
A pity, I liked that one.
Don't feel bad, Ivy. Destroying stone is kind of our thing.
Fly back here, you coward!
We're not catching a gargoyle.
It was a good fight, Kelvin.
Your expedition is over, Kelvin.
You should have skated away!
You're not fast enough, Kelvin.
And that's why you go underground when you're trying to escape!
New York just got a little bit safer.
Lady Geist was a monster that needed to be put down.
Geist needed to be stopped!
You're a long way from the Met, my friend.
Don't get close to Geist!
Geist is going to look to steal your health!

Some humility will do you well, Lash.
If we lost that fight, we would never hear the end of it.
You picked the wrong fight, Lash!
Ahh, Lash, your ego got the better of you.

I... don't like you, Mina.
Mina got what she deserved.

She was a cruel little girl...
Hmph! You're the best the Djinn could hire?
You know, I was expecting more from him.
Perhaps next time we'll be on the same side, Paige.
I liked you, Paige... not enough to not kill you, but enough to feel a little bad about it.

A shame we never started that book club, Paige.
I'll give her a book later, and all will be forgiven.
She was a clever one, but clever only gets you so far.
She made some questionable life decisions.
Oh, she's not going to be happy about that.
You'll have to do better than that, Paradox.
You thought you had an advantage, didn't you?
Let's be honest, that kid made some poor choices.
Pocket is out of commission.
We protected you, Pocket, and you betrayed us!
I expected more from you, Pocket.
Why did you put us in this position?
It did not have to end this way.
He was a cute little guy.
We took down the familiar.
I hope he finds a way home.
A shame he couldn't pick better friends.
If only we got to him sooner. We could've helped him.
So that was the thing prowling our tunnels.
We are not afraid of you, Seven!
We can't let Seven complete the ritual!
You're a slippery, slippery man, Shiv.
You could not run forever, Shiv.
This is going to be a lot harder than we thought, isn't it?
Silver won't be feasting on us.
And here I thought we had a good working relationship with her!
I didn't realise how desperate Silver had gotten... I wish we could've helped her.
Listen, they really did have an incredible stage show. It's a shame what's become of them.
I tire of your rabbit tricks!
We will not be hunted by the likes of you.
We don't answer to the Vatican!
You overstep your bounds, Venator.
Why do I get the feeling he'd turn us into a rug if he had the chance?
Alas, some mysteries will never get solved, Victor.
Victor, you have the soul of a poet... it's a shame you fought with the competence of one as well.
Good luck in your search, Victor, but success eludes you today.
Any other day, and we would've been glad to help you.
We stopped the cadaver man!
The ghost lady is dead!.. Well, she was already dead, I suppose, but now she's even more dead!
Getting our claws on her wasn't easy.
Should have flown away when you had the chance, Vindicta!
You thought you'd be safe up there?
My friend, you have some goo in your fur.
Ugh, I think some of Viscous got in my mouth.
Go back to the deep, goo boy.
I see a whooole lotta goo.
There are the dregs of society, and then there is Vyper.
I'll say this about Vyper... actually, there's nothing nice to say about Vyper, she's just kind of a terrible person.
It is a privilege to give Vyper what was coming to her.
Do not mourn that snake of a woman.
Warden, this isn't a fight for you.
We were never your enemy, Warden. I wish you could have seen that.
I thought we had a deal, Wraith!
You're good at one-on-one fights, Wraith. Too bad there's two of us.
You really thought you'd get the drop on us?
Those parlor tricks of yours were only going to get you so far.
The Seventh Moon will never strong-arm us!
You think we're afraid of you, Yamato?
A sword was never going to be enough to stop us!

This one's one of my favourites!

I will fight as long as I can!
If they want to kill me, they have to work for it.
Ready to use the Lady of the Lake!

The Lady of the Lake will help.

Ohh, I need to have courage.
I know I can count on the Lady of the Lake.
I will be the hero of this story.
I'll do my best to stop them!

This is always a showstopper.

When the chips are down, you can always count on the Knights of the Round Table!
Ready to call on the cavalry.

This is the best part of the story!

Okaaay, this is going good.
Okay, this is going good.

This is getting exciting!
Oh, what have I gotten myself into?

This story's starting to get good!
Can't wait to see how this story plays out!

I don't like messing with this stuff.

Ready to go back to Camelot.
I'm not worried about their magic!
Ready to let 'em have it!

I could get something better.

The right item could make the difference.
I could get something powerful at the store.

There's nothing I can't afford!
No point in saving more souls than this. I need to go shopping.

I should pick up those souls.
Can't leave the souls lying around!
Can't believe someone just left these lying around!

They have to be here somewhere.

I will get you next time!

Oh man, ha!.. I haven't seen my friends in a while.

I need to get back to the team.
Ready to finish the ritual!
We're so close to finishing the ritual!
It's time to summon the Patron!
Don't waste your bullets on 'em!
Oh my God, it's actually about to happen!
This is how lots of great stories begin: with a motley crew that may or may not hate each other!
Hope I brought enough books!
Why did I think doing library Storytime was gonna prepare me for this?
Why do I get the feeling book club would've been safer?
There seems to be a lot more trained killers than I expected.
Thanks so much for your help!
We worked great as a team!
I couldn't have done it without you!
She has a cat. She can't be evil.
That is the angriest grandpa that I have ever seen in my life.
I'll be back when I can, Infernus!
Kelvin can hold his own for a while.
Don't make eye contact, don't make eye contact, don't make eye contact.
Good luck building... killing machines!
That man stepped out of every romance novel ever written.
Oh, it's like the Wind in the Willows with guns.
Man, that lady is so cool!
Good luck killing people, Seven! Ha... oh God, I wished him good luck.
I'm a sucker for a man with a tortured past.
Oh, I would not want to be on her bad side.
I just want to take that ball of goo home and give him a hug.
That guy wasn't read to enough as a kid.
Good luck stabbing, people! Oh, God, I made that awkward.
I can't believe I stopped the detective!
I'm not scared of Abrams or his MacGuffin.
Abrams isn't making it easy for us.
Bebop won't be pulling us for a while.
Hey! I took out a pit fighter!
Why are you angry all the time?!
He's like a bootleg version of Bottom from Midsummer.
Oh, I wish I could just give him a hug.
It wouldn't kill you to be nicer, Billy!
You don't have to be so mean all the time, Billy.
Let's take out Mr. Tumnus.
I can't stay mad at her! She's got a cat!
Calico's been dealt with.
I don't think Calico's gonna take that very well.
That woman was a nightmare.
I know you were just doing your job, I'm- I'm sorry!
I'm not going to be another one of your victims!
You're not winning, Drifter!
I won't let you stalk anyone else!
He seemed nice until he tried to kill me.
Sorry about that, professor.
He always seemed so polite at the library.
Dealt with the professor.
I'm sorry about your family, Talon, I get it, but... I can't let you stop me!
He was like my grandpa if my grandpa was really into shooting people with arrows.
Oh god. What if the OSIC sends a curator to my dad's store?
So, that was a Sandman. That's fine, ha! Everything's fine. She won't come back and kill me in my sleep...
That, um... That was an OSIC agent.
Oh my God, I picked a fight with the federal government.
Man, now that was a cop on the edge!
I don't think they should trust that lady with a gun.
I won't let you stop me, Holliday!
No sir, you will not be lighting my books on fire, thank you very much.
Glad all my books are intact.
Why are you doing this, Infernus?!
He'll burn down everything if we don't stop him!
I can't believe I got to fight the Savior of Spanish Harlem!
Oh my god, why is Ivy fighting me? Am I the bad guy?
Stay away from me, Ivy! I-I'm not the enemy!
I know they say you "don't meet your heroes" and he tried to kill me, but... I don't care! Kelvin. Is. Great!
He was as impressive as the stories said!
Ahh! I get to be the antagonist in one of Kelvin's stories!
This will make the next book signing a little awkward!
So long, Lady Dorian Gray!
Glad to be able to walk away from that one.
Geist is out of the picture!
That guy sure thought highly of himself.
He needs to learn to be nicer to people.
That guy wants to be Heathcliff so bad, but at the end of the day, he's just a dimestore Mr. Collins.
I get why people don't like you, Lash.
You know, when I woke up today, I didn't expect to fight against the Occult Industrial Complex.
And I thought my brother was a curmudgeon.
I hope Fairfax Industry still plans on donating to the library.
Those turrets were only gonna get you so far, McGinnis.
You're not very nice, Mina.
Why are you so mean to people?
I think she has self-esteem issues.
Her parents raised her wrong.
Glad I didn't end up like her.
I wish we were fighting on the same side, Mirage.
I'll find a way to help him later.
This probably isn't the right time to ask if I can show him around New York.
Yeah, you're losing, but at least you have each other. And that counts for something.
Moles are a lot less adorable when they're trying to rip you in half.
I bet that lady stole some really good books.
Sorry, Pocket. I didn't have a choice.
I think they wanted to be here less than me.
Now that right there was someone with a whole lot of feelings.
Why couldn't they just keep an angsty journal, like most people?
I won't let my brother end up like you, Seven!
I couldn't let Seven run free.
Lash should take notes: that's how you pull off the bad boy thing.
I think one of his knives might be stuck in my books.
Sorry, Shiv. That pompadour could only get you so far.
I thought you were supposed to hunt monsters!
The Venator's lost his mind!
The last thing I needed in my life was that guy trying to hunt me down!
Maybe he'll get even moodier!
I wish I could help him...
I-I didn't want to fight you, Victor.
I don't blame her for what she's doing, but she needed to be stopped.
You didn't give me any choice, Vindicta.
Your story deserved a better ending than this, Vindicta.
Viscous, you need to pick better friends.
They're taking advantage of you, Viscous.
I feel like George to his Lennie...
For what it's worth, Viscous... I think your Cube looked neat!
I bet she hangs out with Lash.
That lady is a slimeball.
I hope I never have to see her again.
That guy was playing for keeps!
Glad I'm walking away from that fight.
He's gonna be back, and he will be looking for retribution.
I can't believe I survived a fight with Warden.
I can't believe I'm still standing!
So! I, uh... killed a crime lord. That won't have any repercussions.
Our actions always catch up with us eventually, Wraith.
Well, that's one less crazy lady with a sword running around.
Yamato's been dealt with!
And I thought Wraith was mean.
She's definitely gonna come back and murder me.

name: Paradox
lines: In time, all men die, the gun just speeds things up.
Trust me: You want me on your side.
People who say you can't outrun a bullet have a severe lack of imagination.
Time travel isn't a thing... yet.
Time's a-wastin'! That was a little time joke. Not sure if you picked up on that.
Do- really? Don't expect me to explain how this all works. Just be happy that it works.
No one can stop me from taking what I want.
More time to plan a heist.
That certainly was a choice.
You... realize I create walls of time, right?
Think I'll take a walk through the museum.
You know where to find me if you want my help.
Pulse Grenade's almost ready.
Time manipulation is fun and all, but sometimes you just need explosives.
If you're gonna blow something up, you might as well do it with style!
And to think some people waste their time with normal grenades...
Sometimes you need time tricks, other times, you just need explosives.
This should do some work.
Well if they aren't paying attention, they're as good as dead.
I hope I get to catch someone shopping.
When this goes off, they won't even know what hit them.
There’s a time for elegance… And a time for brute force.
Have I got a surprise for them!
Time Wall's almost ready.
This will help when we push.
I can defend our objectives.
Can't wait to swap people through this.
They'll fight on my terms.
Ouh, this is going to infuriate them!
Ready to support the team.
I should swap 'em through this.
They can't shoot through this.
Ready to speed things up.
Who doesn't love playing with time?
This can disrupt their plans.
I don't have time to play fair.
By the time I slow down, they'll be dead.
Time this right, and it can change the tide of a fight.
Time to pick up the pace.
Got to make every second count.
I'll move them around the battlefield!
I'll try to put them into position!
I'll try to swap them into the group!
They'll go where I tell them.
I'll swap them out of position.
This is a great way to initiate.
If someone's by themselves, I'll drag 'em to where I want them to be.
Getting them out of position can make the difference.
One well-timed swap can change everything...
Ooh, I love using this when they try to run away!
Well they can try to escape. Tch, see how that works out for them.
I'll move them all over the battlefield!
They'll go, where I want them to go.
Hope I get to catch someone delivering an urn.
Got you where I want you.
That's what I like to see.
Now, that was satisfying!
I don't forget. I don't forgive.
Thanks for havin' my back.
Nice to work with someone who's a teamplayer!
I'm just getting started!
This... is only the beginning!
You think I'm bad now? Wait until I get going!
There's more where that came from.
How are you gonna stop me, I manipulate time!
You guys could at least try to stop me!
There's no one better than me!
Well, they can shoot me all they want!
I'm not worried about gettin' shot!
They'll die before they can use their magic!
Need to work on my abilities.
I should get something at the store.
Wonder what they're selling at the store.
I can afford better equipment.
I wonder what's at the shop now.
Bet I could get something good at the shop!
Might be time to get an Item!
I should see what I can afford.
There's nothing I can't afford.
I need to spend these Souls.
Someone left some Souls lying around
Wow, what do we have here?
I'm not leaving Souls lying around!
Closer to completing the ritual.
It's only a matter of time before we summon the Patron!
Now where are you hiding?
They think they're so smart...
I have all the time in the world to kill them.
Barely got out of there...
That coulda gone real bad, real quick!
Need to be careful, I'm all alone...
They could come at me from anywhere.
If I get too greedy, I could get caught.
Just me, I- I need to be smart!
Damn, I'm the only one who got out alive!
There's too many of them!
I've got to be smart about this.
They've got the Rejuvenator!
They took the Rejuvenator, we need to be smart!
They have the Rejuv, let's stick together!
I don't have time to sit around!
Don't bother shooting them!
Don't waste your bullets.
They're not ready for what I've got planned.
I'll put them in their place.
I'll make the opening. Just be sure you're ready to capitalize.
They aren't going to like what I have planned.
Don't worry, boys and girls, time's on our side.
This is going to make a hell of an exhibit in the museum.
It was fun working with you all, we should run another job sometime.
We need to back up Abrams!
That is one tough detective.
I like the way you think, Bebop!
That's one clever scrap golem!
Thought I was in trouble there for a moment!
Thanks for the help, McGinnis!
Thanks for keepin' me in the fight.
Ouh, I need one of these in my safe house!
You're a life-saver, Viscous.
She covered some distance, now didn't she?
Better luck next time, Abrams!
The Tome will be mine, Abrams!
Give me the Tome, detective!
This ends when you give me the Tome.
Help me kill the detective!
You're good Bebop, but you're not good enough.
You're not at my level, Bebop.
I love it when you make it easy for me, Bebop.
Thanks for standin' there for me!
You're makin' this waay too easy, Bebop!
Stop yellin' about your problems and start fixin' 'em, Billy!
You talk too much, Billy...
That bat isn't going to do you a whole lot of good, Billy.
You're not better than me, Calico!
I thought she was rather charming! A shame it had to end this way...
Calico isn't a real threat.
Calico didn't have what it takes.
I will learn the secrets of The Baroness, Doorman.
You can't keep me out of The Baroness forever, Doorman!
Get away from me, Drifter!
He needed to be put down!
For such a brilliant mind, you make some stupid choices!
I took out the professor!
Don't have to worry about that black hole for a while...
You're out of your league, Dynamo!
Dynamo is makin' his move.
Look out for the black hole!
He didn't stand a chance!
I was expecting so much more from him...
Your little owl was never going to catch me!
The OSIC isn't particularly impressive now, is it?
You think you can take me out, Haze?
Pissing off Haze was probably a bad idea...
The Cursed Apple may not be the place for you, sheriff!
You've never fought someone like me, Holliday!
I might have to take her revolver...
That gun has history, Holliday, I want it!
I'll be right here, sheriff!
Of course she bounces away!
You should never have tried lighting me on fire.
You've been out of the game too long, Infernus!
You've lost a step, Infernus!
I took down the gargoyle!
Ivy, you couldn't stop me on your best day!
There's different levels to this, Ivy... You aren't ready.
Stick to petty crooks and Spanish Harlem, Ivy!
We could've worked well together, Kelvin.
Knocked Kelvin off his high horse.
I think I found a new favorite person to mess with!
You made the wrong enemy, Kelvin.
You really are fun to mess with, Lady Geist!
She really has a high opinion of herself, doesn't she?
I'm not scared of you, Geist.
Come on, Lash! You've got to do better than that!
You don't get it, Lash. We fight on my terms, not yours.
I want your research, McGinnis.
What secrets are you hiding for Fairfax, McGinnis?
I'm gonna rob that woman blind!
Your time is runnin' short, McGinnis!
The turrets aren't gettin' it done, McGinnis
She can keep throwin' them down, and I'll keep breakin'em.
How many of these damn things is she carrying?
What a useless vampire...
Mina, you're not special because your Mummy and Daddy paid for someone to turn you into a vampire.
She probably had more clout before she was turned.
Tell you what Mirage: Give me the Djinn, and I'll let you walk.
Honor gets you killed, Mirage.
That guy needs to lighten up!
It's a shame, I liked those two!
Bet she has some rare books worth stealin'.
I took care of the bookworm.
Tell yer little fairy tales somewhere else!
Their support's out of the picture.
I see the prodigal child has returned.
So the heir to Fairfax Industries has graced us with their presence.
I want that case, Pocket!
Just give me the case, Pocket, save us all some time!
You can change your name, Arin, but I know who you really are.
He's as powerful as they say.
So that's the man that escaped Lost Whisper.
Another Baxter Society errand boy... dealt with.
You have knives, I have time! It was never going to be a fair fight.
You're not gonna be stoppin' me, Shiv!
Was wondering when they'd send you after me.
Knew this was bound to happen one day.
Get off my back, Venator!
Smile more, Victor. Life is more fun that way.
Yer not going to win, Victor!
You're never going to find answers on your own, Victor.
Vindicta isn't a threat to me.
I have your number, Vindicta!
Vindicta, you're out of time.
You've picked the wrong target, Vindicta!
You're clever, Viscous, but you're not me.
That cube was only going to last so long...
You give thieves a bad name, Vyper.
You're an insult to my profession, Vyper.
Warden, you've never faced someone like me in your life!
Better luck next time, Warden!
Love the conviction, Warden!
Don't worry about the Patrons, Warden; worry about me.
Don't get too close to Warden!
And here I thought we could do business.
I'm not afraid of you, Wraith.
The Seventh Moon will never run New York.
Yamato, Yamato, Yamato... When will you realize you're not in control?
I can't wait to steal that sword!
Yamato will never stop me!

name: Pocket
lines: I'll do whatever it takes to keep this case from my father.
I'll use my family's name when I'm no longer ashamed of it.
My father's gift for my 18th birthday was a bullet to the chest. Today is my chance to say "thank you".
We can build a better world.
I don't like to talk about my past. But I'm ready to move forward.
I've waited years for this. I can't waste this chance.
This isn't about revenge.
I'm tired of lying to my friends and to myself.
I wish there was another way, but my father gave me no choice.
I think the worst part is that... my father would be more proud of me if I was trying to kill him rather than trying to stop him.
I'm not ready to face him yet.
I need more time to prepare.
I can't go through with this.
Maybe there's another way.
Ah... what was I thinking?
I just need a moment to compose myself.
I need more time to plan.
To hell with Fairfax Industries, I just want peace!
There has to be a better way than violence.
If I have to stand my ground, I will.
This was never supposed to be a weapon.
I have to be willing to fight.
This case is full of surprises.
My father chose violence, not me.
Today is not the day for idealism.
I'm sorry for what I'm about to do.
I can't let them push me around.
Sometimes, violence is a necessary evil.
You shouldn't have made the spirits mad.
This case isn't running out of ghosts anytime soon.
I'll fight with everything I have!
I can still pull this off!
I'll keep them on their toes.
I can use this to escape, or approach.
I need to stay unpredictable.
I'll keep them off-balance.
I know how to live on the run.
Getting ready to teleport!
Bet they weren't planning for this!
I can still make it out of here!
Come on, come on, come on, come on!
Ready to hide in my case!
Suitcase is almost ready.
They can't get through this.
I'll be safe in this case.
This is how I stayed alive all these years.
It's more comfortable than it looks.
It saved my life before, and it will do it again.
I know how to get out of a sticky situation.
Getting the timing right is crucial.
If you need me, I'll be hiding in this thing.
They're trying to kill me!
I don't remember New York being so dangerous!
Without this case, I'd be dead.
Just gonna buy some time!
My case has some surprises ready!
I hope I don't have to use what's inside this thing.
If they get close to me, they'll regret it.
If they get too close, they'll pay for it.
I'll do whatever it takes to win!
They need to stay out of my way if they don't wanna be hurt!
I don't have time for passive resistance!
Time to take off the kid gloves.
Affliction's almost ready!
Affliction's on cooldown.
The power in this case is terrifying.
Better me in charge of this power than my father.
I hope I'm not a monster for using this.
I never wanted to spread misery, but looks like today I'll have to.
God help us if my father ever got his hands on this power.
It'll hurt 'em, but at least it won't kill 'em.
Who knows what else this case is capable of?
We weren't meant to wield this much power.
It's the spirits killing them, not me.
Good god, what am I about to do?
Their life will dwindle away.
The inevitable comes for us all.
I wish it didn't have to go this way.
I'm becoming more and more like my father.
Heh. Dad would be proud...
I didn't come this far just to die now.
Your life had value. I'm sorry.
Please, just stay out of my way.
I can't let anyone stand in my way.
That came so naturally...
I hate that I'm getting good at this.
I can't change the world if I'm dead.
The powerful get what they deserve.
Every legacy comes to an end eventually.
Together, we can change the world!
I didn't want it to come to this.
You're making me do this.
I'm becoming someone I didn't want to be.
If this is what I have to do, so be it!
Please give up. Don't make me kill you.
This is the price I have to pay to do the right thing.
Surrender. Don't throw your lives away any more than you already have.
I am the rightful heir of Fairfax Industries and it will be mine.
I'm building a new legacy.
The war is over! You've lost!
I need to upgrade my powers.
I should train my abilities.
Can't forget to train my powers!
Can't afford to leave money laying around!
I can't just leave souls behind.
They couldn't have gone far.
I have to be ready for when they come back.
Can't chase 'em down now.
I've survived death before. I can do it again.
I'm getting way too used to almost dying.
Might be time to meet up with the others.
The enemy could be anywhere.
I always knew it would fall on me.
I'm a Fairfax. I can handle the pressure.
There's too many of them!
Staying here might not be smart.
Good job picking up the Rejuv!
We got the Rejuv, now we need a plan.
They have the Rejuvenator!
They have the Rejuv. It's time to regroup!
They're putting us on the defensive!
It's time to end this once and for all.
We need to finish the ritual!
It's time to summon the Patron.
This will all be over soon.
I need to get back to my team!
If we work together, we'll win.
New York got a lot more intense than I remembered.
I'll fight for what I believe in.
I promise I won't spend all my time in the suitcase.
Wasn't the outcome I was expecting.
That coulda gone either way.
I'm glad I trusted you guys.
Thanks for your help, Abrams.
Calico got what she deserved!
See you when I can, Talon!
Glad the OSIC isn't after the case.
See ya out there, Holliday.
Do what you have to do, Lady Geist.
Karma's coming for you, Maggie.
I'm not crying that Maggie's dead.
You guys take care of yourselves, okay?
They'll be getting into trouble in no time.
I'll be back out there soon.
Hope they signed a prenup!
Glad you're with us, Vindicta.
Wonder how long before she turns on us?
Someone finally killed Vyper!
I'll join you when I can, Warden.
Be back when I can, Wraith.
I took out the detective.
That could've gone real bad.
Today's gonna be exhausting, isn't it?
He's lucky. At least he has a mother who'll mourn him.
Well, if I don't retake my company at least I have a future in the Bear Pit.
You're a good son, Bebop.
I was wondering when I'd see you again.
Calico's been dealt with.
Don't worry, I'll take care of Ava.
I suppose this was inevitable.
I knew I couldn't count on you.
Why are you making me do this?
It was never supposed to be this way.
I should've known you'd take my father's side.
Professor Dynamo is dead.
He may be old, but he's still dangerous.
I used to read about him!
That man didn't care he was about to die.
He fought with everything he had.
The government was never gonna stop Fairfax Industries... but I can.
Well, if the government didn't already hate my family enough...
I don't want trouble with the OSIC, but I can't let you win.
Why can't she just take a bribe and leave me alone?
I don't want trouble with the law...
I'm sorry about what happened in Macomb, but that has nothing to do with me.
I gotta do what I gotta do, Holliday.
Great, now I'm a fugitive from my father and the law.
Guess I won't be having that drink later.
He wasn't a bad guy-- just put in a bad situation.
Just lucky I wasn't burned alive.
Maybe I should've stayed in hiding.
Ivy's been taken care of.
I took out their support!
Why am I fighting a hero? What's wrong with me?
She seemed kind. She'll understand.
I idolized him when I was younger.
The dead need to stay buried.
Lady Geist has been handled.
I couldn't let her prey on my people.
I know insecurity when I see it.
And I thought my dad had an ego.
Someone needed to shut him up.
Couldn't have happened to a nicer guy.
I'll sleep just fine tonight.
Tell my father to go to hell.
You could've made the world a better place. Instead, you chose to do this.
You're complicit, McGinnis.
Fairfax Industries needs to die.
The Djinn will have to wait. I'm sorry.
Great, I just might've created an international incident.
I'm not worried about the Djinn.
They were loyal 'til the end.
Why are you making me do this guys?
I thought we were friends.
You can dress up however you want but at the end of the day, you're just another rich asshole.
Maybe my dad was right about you guys.
I really didn't want to make enemies with Paradox today.
God, if he ever teamed up with my father...
He'll be back and I need to be ready.
I can't let Seven get what he wants from the Patrons.
You're no different than Calico.
We won't be seeing Shiv for a while.
I see that handsome bastard.
Now's not the time for whimsy.
That was one of the weirder fights I've been in.
They needed a better assistant.
You don't want to change the world. You just want to watch it burn!
You mistake rage for having a vision.
How many assassination attempts do I need to survive?
I won't be another one of your victims, Vindicta.
He should've stayed in the cube.
I'm becoming a monster, aren't I?
Vyper, you are the worst.
That was one desperate woman.
She makes my parents look stable.
Everyone knows not to trust you, Vyper.
Obsession isn't a substitute for talent.
Stop living your parents' life and lead your own!
Don't take it out on Mo and Krill!
I don't need your help, Wraith!
She would get along with my mother.
I won't let you cut me down.
Thought she almost had me...

name: Rem
lines: No more sleeping, need to help, then sleep more.
I summon Patron, then I go home.
No patrons needed. I'll find my way.
My bed is cozy and the outside is mean.
Wanna see how far I can throw this?
It's soft for me, but it's not soft for them!
Ima hit em with a pillow!
Ima throw my pillow at 'em cause I'm carryin' a pillow and that's really all I can throw!
Well, I'm not gonna throw my candle at 'em, that would be crazy!
It's comfy, and dangerous.
Pillow is almost ready...
I'm not throwing my pillow, I'm using my pillow...
I'm going to go sleep now...
Tag along's almost ready.
I wanna hang out with my new friends.
I think I might need a nap.
I'll feel better after a nap.
They'll like havin' me around.
I'm gettin' a lil sleepy.
I like working with people.
I'm just gonna close my eyes for a second.
The best part of being asleep, is being asleep.
Viscous likes cubes. I like pillows...
Helping hand's almost ready.
Helping hand's on cooldown.
They're good at doing things I'm too lazy to do, heh.
Friends help each other out.
It's not safe to travel alone.
They great at shuffleboard.
Friends are almost ready.
I don't know, you guys do it.
Ready to put them to sleep.
Ready for a slumber party.
I can put them to sleep now.
Let me know when you want them to go to bed.
I'm ready, but I'm tired.
Everyone should take more naps.
People are grumpy when they're tired.
People can't be mean when they're asleep.
I'm always ready for bed.
I'm not ready to sleep, I'm awake.
Can't be mad when you're asleep.
It's okay, Mr. Washington, you can be president.
You should be nicer to me!
I just wanted to take a nap!
I guess havin' a lot of souls doesn't solve all your problems.
You weren't nice to me earlier.
I don't know what's happening, but it's a lot.
What do you mean I can't eat ice cream on a roller coaster?..
I got a good feeling 'bout this!
I'm glad I'm awake to see this!
Of course they can't stop me, I've brought my lucky pillow!
No one stops me from goin' home!
My friends are gonna win!
They should be nicer to me...
I'm not scared, you're scared.

I think I'm gonna stick with you guys.
Anyone else wanna take a nap?

He thought he was better than me.
I don't know if he's mean, but he's definitely not nice.
You shouldn't play with swords.

I probably shouldn't hang out with Billy 'til I'm older.

I agree, Vindicta. Shoes are stupid.

I don't know what this guy's deal is.
She had four arms, that's weird.
Maybe she'd fight better if her hands weren't in her pockets.
I don't know what "degenerate gambler" means, but it sounds fun!
I think people would like her more if she stopped trying to stab everybody.

name: Seven

With these hands I will destroy, and with these hands I will rebuild.

Ah, I have a burgeoning empire to run anyway.
One day you'll need me. And I'll see you beg for my help.
It's true, I am intimidating.
When you want victory, I'll be ready.
One day, you will fail. And when you do, remember this moment. The moment you could have chosen victory.
It's adorable that you think you don't need me.
Ready to throw lightning.
Ball lightning is almost ready.
Lightning Ball's on cooldown!
Such a small thing that can cause so much damage.
This will tear through their ranks.
In time, this will wear down any objective.

One little spark is all it takes.
I will dismantle their guardians.
If they don't move, they'll be dead.

They will writhe, then they will die.
They'll know the end is coming.

There's no avoiding this.
They have no chance for escape.
There's no escaping the inevitable.
Power Surge is almost ready!
Power Surge is on cooldown!
They won't hide behind the weak.

My reputation is well-earned.

Only those who keep their wits about them will survive.
This will break their spirit.
They would be wise to fear me.
All who oppose us will die!
The current courses through me!
Ugh, this isn't over yet!
Their team is down, let's take what's ours!
I bought us time. Let's make good use of it!
I don't need a team to kill them all.
Kelvin! You can't run from me forever!
That should send a message.
I'm no stranger to blood on my hands.
They'll be dead to the last man.
Today, justice will be served.
You were outmatched from the beginning.
Ugh... I got your filth all over me.
That should take the smug look off their face.
You thought you were better than me?!
We're a well-oiled machine!
And that's how you remove an obstacle!
It's nice to have quality help.
You will see what true power looks like!
Be honored to die at my hand.
Walk away from this. It won't get better.
Has the futility set in yet?
The city will know my brilliance!
Feel free to hide. It only delays the inevitable.

Your powers mean nothing!
Their life force will be mine.
The weak will sustain the strong!

I can't forget to upgrade my abilities.

I can get something new at the store.
I can't let these souls go to waste.
There's nothing I can't afford!
I should pay the Curiosity Shop a visit.
The right purchase can cement our victory!
I've planned for everything.
Souls wait to be claimed!
I should pick up those souls!
There's money over there!
This money belongs to me.
The dead have no use for coin!
Enjoy your Pyrrhic moment.
The objective was all that mattered.
Look at them scramble for some dignity!
The money's irrelevant. The objective is what really mattered.
We'll pick them off, one by one.
I slipped through their fingers.
That could have gone bad.
Their best wasn't good enough.
I don't have backup... I need to be careful.
Need to make sure I check in with the others...
And once again, I am the Omega!
I'm not looking to die like the rest of my team.
They're moving as a pack...
It's not wise to engage on my own.
And now we press our advantage!
Damn it! They got the Rejuvenator!
They got the Rejuvenator, we need a plan!
They have the Rejuvenator; we can't afford to throw our lives away!
I need to get back to work.
My team needs me out there!
Enough rest! It's time to fight!
Don't waste your bullets!
You're on your own for now.
I need some medical attention!

No one will stop me from getting what I deserve.
Greatness can be hindered, but it can never be stopped.
I tire of sulking in the shadows.
I remain unshackled by limits, or fear.
Their suffering is as irrelevant as it is inevitable.
You all played your parts to perfection.
My greatness will no longer be denied.
Soon, the Patrons will bow to me.
Look on the face of your new god!
We need to capitalize on this!
Now! While they're stunned!
It's a joy watching you work, Abrams.
No one is stopping Abrams!
The detective will run through them all!
Bebop is pulling them in!
The Guardian will deal with them.
Time for the Guardian to earn its keep.
Strike while they're helpless!
Your kindness has been noted.

Precise as always, Talon!
You're a woman of talent, Haze!

Ivy... You are saccharine, but useful.
Don't you ignore me, Kelvin!
Eh. They took out Kelvin.
Kelvin's dead! That saved me some time later.
They killed Kelvin! Someone's getting a fruit basket later!
What game are you playing at, Kelvin?
Like old times, eh Kelvin?
Don't think this buys my loyalty.
I thought they had you, Geist.
I underestimated you, Lash.
Right where we wanted them.
I appreciate you, McGinnis.
You're always looking out, McGinnis.
Now! While Krill has them!
Letting someone else do the work, eh Paradox?
Paradox stole us the Rejuvenator!
Paradox played her part to perfection.
That man has earned my respect.

Shiv is ruthless! I love it!

What a fascinating creature.
Go back to your little sideshow.
She has more power than she lets on...
Today has gotten rather interesting now, hasn't it?

That woman is a nuisance!
Paradox won't be bothering us for a while.
I tire of your games, Paradox.
I won't be killed by the likes of you, Paradox.
You were a fool to fight me, Paradox.
We've been robbed by Paradox!
Paradox will answer for this!
This is not the place for a child.
Learn from your betters, Pocket.
Pocket's been dispatched.
I almost feel a twinge of guilt... Fascinating...

Shiv won't be bothering us for a while.
The Baxter Society will fall!
I need help stopping Shiv!

Shiv is going to try to stick us.

Better luck next time, Wraith.
You have plenty of style, Wraith. Just no substance.
Wraith will try to pick us off.
Your dynasty ends here, Yamato.
Leave New York while you still can, Yamato.
The Seventh Moon should never have gotten in my way.

I'm not even close to finished.

New York is under my protection now!
Gettin' chilly 'round here!
I'll meld into the shadows.
Time to bring down the mighty.

I'm not worried about your little tricks!
I can improve my technique.
Gotta work on my abilities.
Gotta remember to train up.
Can't forget to buy gear.
I should check out the shop.
I should see what I can afford.
Wonder what they got at the store?
I can get somethin' quality!
Might be time to pick up somethin' new.
It's time to buy the best!
There's nothin' I can't afford!
No point in savin' anymore.
Another part of the ritual complete.
Good job takin' the objective.
One less objective to worry about.
Soon we'll summon the Patrons.
You won't escape next time!
Keep runnin', friend! I'll get you soon enough.
They're really makin' me work for it.
If I were a lesser man, I'd be dead.
They're gonna have to try a lot harder than that to kill me.
Don't got any support nearby.
If I'm out here by myself, I need to stay alert.
Of course it comes down to me.
Time to take the fight to them!
They got the Rejuvenator!
Damn it, they got the Rejuv!
They got the Rejuvenator, we need a plan!

Can't leave my friends to fight alone.
Time to finish the ritual!
There's a whole lotta people that don't got enough knives stuck in 'em.
Time to get back to work.
Bullets ain't gonna hurt 'em!
Might be time to pull back.
Professionals get it done.
I'm gonna stab a whole lotta people today.
They're gonna regret pickin' a fight with the Baxter Society.
I'm here to win, not play games!
I'll prove to the old man that I'm worthy.
I got enough knifes for everyone!

Calico, you're not half as dangerous as you think you are.
You belong in the classroom, not a fight!
Welcome to the big time, Dynamo!
No black holes for you, Dynamo.
Sorry about that ma'am, but ya had to go.
Haze ain't huntin' no one no more.
Haze won't be botherin' us for a while.
We should have worked together, Holliday.
Don't worry, Holliday. When this is over I'll kill the Troubadour on your behalf.
Holliday won't be a problem.

Dammit Fern, don't make me do this!

That was one evil son of a bitch.
