You have no idea what I'm capable of...
The coward dies many deaths, the valiant; only one!
They put up quite the fight...
Our courage never wavered!
Abrams is turning the tide!
Abrams bought us some time.
They'll never stop Abrams!
That man fights like a demon! That's... Barely unsurprising, actually.
Our defences will take care of them.
They killed the professor!
Excellent shot, Grey Talon.
I don't know where you are, Talon, but thank you.
Salvation comes in many forms.
Haze made short work of them all.
That was beautiful to watch.
I could learn from watching her.
Now that was some finesse, Haze!
Your training served you well, Haze.
Hold them still, Holliday!
You made short work of the objective, Infernus.
Infernus reduced that to cinders.
Thanks for the assist, Ivy.
We make a good team, Ivy.
You kept me in the fight, Kelvin.
I'm in your debt, Kelvin.
I knew I could count on you, Kelvin.
Oathkeeper is a nightmare!
You're a real bastard, Lash.
They couldn't be happy about that.
Thanks for the assist, McGinnis.
You stopped them, McGinnis!
Your timing is impeccable!
I'm in debt to a giant mole...
They didn't see that coming, did they?
It's impressive watching Shiv work.
He just dances between them effortlessly.
Look at that knifework...
Looks like he's not a fop after all.
Don't stop fighting, Shiv!
Your precision is humbling.
They never even saw that coming!
I never thought I'd be grateful for being stuck in a cube.
I thought I was dead for sure.
Thanks for the set-up, Wraith.
There's no escape for you!
Your skill is unmatched, Yamato.
The Tome must be destroyed.
Your will is strong detective, but not strong enough.
For God's sake, die already!
The will of man is stronger than any machine.
Go back to the scrapyard, Bebop.
You need to be faster then that, friend.
You opened yourself up for that.
Dealt with the professor.
Don't lecture me, Dynamo.
I can't let you complete the ritual, Dynamo.
Don't make me do this, Talon.
How can you, of all people, align yourself with that thing?
Grey Talon is on the hunt.
I need to look out for that owl.
I can't let Grey Talon catch me!
The OSIC is out of their depth.
Even you have your limits, Haze.
I won't be intimidated by you, Haze!
I expected more from you, Haze.
You can't hide from me, Haze!
You were never going to escape me!
You made your choice, Holliday.
We could've worked together, Holliday...
You chose this path, Sheriff.
You can't run forever, Holliday!
That's right, bounce away!
I won't let you burn New York.
This plane is not your playground.
There'll be none of that.
She was a noble creature...
You're meddling in things you don't understand, Ivy.
Come back here, gargoyle!
Of course she flew away...
The dead should stay buried.
I took out their support.
Kelvin should be out of our hair for a little while.
He'll be back sooner then I'd like.
You can't run from me, Kelvin.
A worthy attempt, Kelvin.
There's nowhere to run to, Kelvin.
You're an abomination, Geist.
Oathkeeper will die with you.
Be careful! Geist can swap!
Don't let Geist drain you!
Be careful when engaging Geist!
You mistake ego for competence, Lash.
You have met your better, Lash.
Stick to fighting town drunks, Lash.
I have no tolerance for bullies!
There's always someone more dangerous, Lash.
Poor, predictable Lash...
Quit while you can, Lash!
Man was never meant to play God, McGinnis.
Fairfax Industries needs to fall.
Your inventions cannot save you.
McGinnis won't be bothering us for a while.
You don't have enough turrets to stop me!
These machines' the best you can muster?!
Plant all the turrets you want McGinnis, I'll destroy them all!
I can't let you succeed, Mirage.
You won't complete the ritual, Mirage!
I respect the man's conviction.
The Tunnel Rats have been dealt with.
They thought they could have their way with us.
To think I was worried about the Time Thief...
All your power... And you squander it on petty nonsense.
Paradox, if you applied yourself you might actually be dangerous.
Paradox... You mascarade as having a code, when really you are driven by nothing but ego!
Pride will only get you so far, Paradox.
Reposition me all you like; the result is the same!
Your little time tricks were never gonna be enough!
You think you had the advantage there, Paradox?!
This war isn't meant for you, Pocket.
I believe you want to change the world for the better, Pocket... But you picked the wrong friends.
That case will be your undoing, Pocket.
Don't worry. I'll take care of that case for you.
You're a monster Seven, and I won't let your sins go unpunished.
No mercy awaits the likes of you, Seven.
We have nothing to fear from Seven.
You will pay for every life you took!
I can't be caught in that electrical storm!
I need to get out of here!
Is this what the Baxter Society has turned into?
Spend less time on your hair, and more time learning how to fight.
You look better, I fight better.
Someone stop him from healing!
Your vengeance is justified, Vindicta, but your time has long since passed.
I put the spirit to rest.
There was no escaping me, Vindicta.
You won't prey on my friends anymore.
Vindicta's trying to take me out!
I need to find some cover!
Vindicta has me in her sights!
There's no flying away from me.
You thought you were untouchable, didn't you Vindicta?
You're no one's king, Viscous.
Took down the... Goo thing.
Who did you think you were fighting, Viscous?
I won't be one of your victims, Wraith.
Money won't keep you warm in the coffin, Wraith.
Wraith... Picking a fight with me was a mistake.
This is the beginning of the end for the Seventh Moon.
Your training failed you, Yamato.
You fought with grace, Yamato, but that will only get you so far.
I won't let the Seventh Moon get a foothold in New York!
This city is under my protection, Yamato!

name: Wraith
lines: If you think crime doesn't pay, you are outrageously bad at crime.
No one builds an empire without sacrifice.
The great part about being a degenerate gambler is that you get really good at setting up your own action. Broke? Yeah. Bored? Never.
I don't appreciate the news labeling some of my services as "rackets". Who wouldn't love being protected by me?
You think I handle money? Please. That stuff is filthy.
"Blackmail" sounds so sleazy. I prefer... "information retention services".
Friends are just acquaintances you feel bad for extorting.
Some people say it's better to be feared than loved. Those people totally get it.
See, I bet you were gonna do that. I just made 5 bucks.
That's fine, got some legs to break anyway.
It shouldn't take you too long to realize you made a mistake.
Good timing. I was planning on getting rid of some loose ends today anyway.
Can't help, I need to go over my ledger. People always underestimate how important the "organized" part of "organized crime" is.
So long as you don't mess with my business, we're good.
You need to find a craps or poker game? Give me a call.
Card Trick's almost ready.
They're not gonna like this trick.
I'll seek out our enemies.
Who doesn't love a good card trick?
Let's stack up some bodies.
They can't outrun my mind.
I don't need a gun to kill a man.
They'll be running from me in no time.
Death comes in many forms.
I'm not going out without a fight!
I need all the help I can get.
No one is gonna catch me.
I move with the speed of thought.
I know how to make an exit.
I'll slip through their fingers.
They can try to pin me down all they want.
Always have an escape plan.
If things go bad, I'll be ready.
Almost ready to open fire.
Rapid Fire's on cooldown.
Sometimes there's things to be said for brute force.
I'll tear through their armour.
Time to line up a firing squad.
I got enough bullets for everyone.
If we're coordinated, this will be devastating!
Gotta remember to use this after I have someone lifted.
If something's stationary, it won't last long.
We'll burn 'em down quickly.
Give 'em everything you got!
They'll be helpless once they're levitating.
When they're floating, they'll be easy to take out.
You're gonna love my next trick!
If we catch someone on their own, they're as good as dead!
There's no escape from me.
They're gonna squirm in the air.
They're about to feel helpless.
Not much they can do about this.
I make my own opportunites.
I catch 'em alone, they're all mine.
They're about to find out who they're messing with.
I don't have a lotta time, but it'll be enough.
Perfect way to start a fight.
We gotta take 'em out or I'm dead.
Got time for one more trick!
They thought that was gonna be enough?
Hope they got the message.
No one is stopping me from finishing the ritual!
There's no one better at what I do!
You were outclassed. Simple as that.
Better people than you have tried to kill me.
You thought you could get up close with me?
They threw their life away.
They got cocky and they paid for it.
No one is untouchable. No one.
I didn't forget what you did.
We keep fighting as a team; we'll win.
I'm just gettin' warmed up.
This is only the beginning.
If you think this is impressive, wait until I get going.
Feel free to give up anytime.
No one is stopping me from getting what I want.
Go home and save us all some time.
You'll never be my equal.
No one is better than me. No one.
You could at least try to make it a challenge.
You never should've gotten close!
This isn't their lucky day.
Let's see you sustain now.
I got tricks up my sleeve.
They can shoot me all they want.
They won't get to use their little tricks!
Let me show you what I'm capable of!
Let's see what this tommy gun can do.
Ready to improve my skills.
I can improve my abilities.
I should get some new gear.
Wonder what I can get at the shop.
I can afford something new.
Should do a little shopping.
There has to be something at the shop I can use!
I gotta spend these souls.
I need to use these souls I saved up.
There's nothing I can't get at the shop!
This fight'll be over soon.
And you thought you had a plan.
I should get those souls.
Shouldn't leave these lying around!
If they're gonna leave it here, I'm gonna take it.
I'll take whatever I can get.
One step closer to completing the ritual.
The ritual will be complete in no time.
We got the objective, that's what's important.
You won't be lucky next time!
Next time, I'll get 'em for sure.
I can't help anyone if I'm dead.
God, that makes me feel alive!
I'm lucky I got out in one piece.
The enemy could be here any second!
Gotta keep my eye out for the enemy.
Oh God, everyone else is dead.
Well... looks like it's up to me!
I don't like the math here.
They have the Rejuvenator!
They got the Rejuv! Not great, but we can still work this out!
Can't let them have all the fun without me!
Don't waste your bullets!
I need to find a place to heal.
Now that's a job well done!
Well, aren't we a fun bunch of malcontents?
This is everyone's first time summoning an Elder God, right?
I'm not trying to be cocky. I'm just saying: On paper, our team should totally kick the shit out of them.
I don't suppose anyone wants to place bets on who dies first.
We're gonna pick them off one by one.
If they think they're winning, they're in for some serious disappointment.
I'd be happy to put any of you on my payroll!
That was one hell of a fight!
Glad it went the way it did.
That could have gone bad, but we kept it together!
It was fun working with you guys.
We gotta follow Abrams in.
You just can't stop that guy!
Be with you when I can, Bebop.
Don't die on me, professor!
Thanks for the help, professor.
Looks like someone took their arthritis medication!
Not gonna lie, I was making fun of the bow until I saw you use it.
Grey Talon was looking out for us.
Glad the OSIC isn't hunting me.
Be careful out there, Holliday.
I'll be back when I can, Fern.
Feels good working together again, doesn't it?
You were born for this, Infernus.
Admit it, Infernus: you're havin' fun!
There goes the gargoyle...
Told you we'd make a good team, Ivy!
That thing didn't last long.
We should work together more often!
That's one heroic dead man.
Thanks for having my back.
You and your creepy arm have fun!
Geist has 'em just where she wants 'em!
They walked straight into that!
They can't be happy about that.
Have fun out there, McGinnis!
That didn't go their way.
Hate to be on the receiving end of that!
That coulda been real bad.
I like the way you think, Paradox.
Don't get in too much trouble, kid.
He, uhhh, wasn't messin' around.
Good job, Seven, you just... Keep killing everyone!
That guy knows how to use a knife!
They don't have an answer for Shiv!
You're a hell of a sniper, Vindicta!
There goes one weird pile o' goo.
Be with you soon, Warden.
That is one scary lady with a sword.
Glad you're on our side, Yamato.
Sorry Abe, it wasn't personal.
He's not gonna forget that anytime soon.
That's one way to lose a customer.
What does it take to stop Abrams?
Glad I'm walking away from that fight.
Try to hook me again and see what happens.
Gotta be faster than that, Bebop.
All you did was make yourself a target!
I expected more from you, Bebop!
Won't be seeing a black hole for a while.
Should've stayed in the classroom, professor.
Here comes the professor!
You're a tough old bastard, aren't you Talon?
Sorry about your family, Talon, but it's got nothing to do with me.
I can't let anyone stand in my way.
If he was in his prime, I'd probably be dead.
Grey Talon's looking for us.
I wasn't looking to start anything with the OSIC.
Oh, great, now I have heat with the feds.
This is gonna make running my business a lot harder.
Stay out of my head, Haze.
You can't hide from me, Haze.
I'm not scared of the feds.
You can't outsmart me, Haze!
Go back to the cornfield, Holliday.
New York's not for everybody, Holliday.
You're not welcome in New York.
I thought you wanted out of the life, Fern.
This is what I get for believing you, Fern.
Shame. He was a hell of a bartender.
You made me do that, Fern.
You never should have come for me, Infernus.
That could have went poorly.
Keep coming at me and I'll make Spanish Harlem the next place I set up shop.
Tch. "Savior of Spanish Harlem."
You can't run forever, Ivy.
Your exploring days are over.
Thought you were supposed to be some hero, Kelvin.
This ain't Rockefeller Center, buddy.
You were never skating away from me.
Fun chase, but it's over.
It was never gonna work out for you, Geist.
You picked the wrong lady to prey on.
You had a good run, Lady Geist, but it's my time now.
Just die with some dignity, Geist.
Geist is looking to drain life!
Don't get close to Geist!
Geist can swap! Be careful!
Lash, Lash, Lash. When are you gonna learn?
What's the matter, Lash? Thought you were a tough guy.
Keep running your mouth, Lash. It's only gonna get worse for you.
Lash, if you can't stop Bebop, you can't stop me.
You're making this too easy, Lash.
Takes more than machines to stop me.
Fairfax needs better help.
Don't need to worry about McGinnis for a while.
And she thought she was sooo smart.
I'll tear down all your machines, McGinnis.
How many of these things does she have?!
Look, when this is all over, I'll buy you a drink and say I'm sorry.
Thought you boys were smart enough not to take me on.
Dealt with the time thief.
Paradox won't be bothering us for a while.
Should've stayed out of my way, Paradox.
You didn't really think that would get it done, did ya?!
You don't got what it takes, Paradox.
Cute trick, next time: try one that works.
You honestly thought you could stop me, Pocket?
Kid, you should be wasting your time at the pool hall not getting shot at.
You didn't know who you were messing with, did you?
Hope I don't see that guy again soon.
I knew the feds were overselling how tough you were, Seven.
No one terrorizes my friends.
You're not in control, Seven.
Thought the Baxter Society hunted monsters.
You make a good looking corpse, Shiv.
When this is over, I should ask about his stylist.
Picked the wrong fight, Shiv.
I won't let the Baxter Society get in my way.
Vindicta's little vengeance spree is over.
I'm not some tourist you can pick off, Vindicta.
Put on some damn shoes, lady.
She probably thought she was safe up there.
Why do I feel bad about shooting a pile of goo?
Aw, Viscous. You were dumb, but kind of adorable.
Nothing scarier than a man with conviction.
I'm not a fan of zealots.
Warden's out of commission.
You're not getting a foothold in New York.
I don't bow to the Seventh Moon.
We could have been friends, Yamato.
Your dreams of expansion have come to an end.

name: Yamato
lines: I inherited this name from my brother.
I received this name for a reason. It must never be tarnished.
If I die, someone else will inherit this sword. Just as I did.
I'll cut down anyone in my way.
Follow me! I'll lead you to victory.
I'll build a mountain of corpses.
New York will fall into the hands of the Seventh Moon.
I wish my brother could have seen this spectacle.
Brother, watch over me. Soon your dream will become reality.
Sooner or later, you'll realize it. That you need the power of the Seventh Moon.
I don't have time to spare either.
Call me again when you're ready.
A foolish decision. Do as you please.
You're refusing the help of the Seventh Moon.
I guess we'll see the bloodshed another time.
Power Slash is almost ready.
Power Slash is not ready.
This will bring about more deaths.
The sword is nothing more than a catalyst. My will is the true weapon.
They will be terrified of this sharpness.
I'll teach you that keeping your distance is pointless.
Brother... I offer you fresh blood.
I'll cut them all to shreds.
I've finally mastered this technique.
This sword thirsts for blood.
I must quench this sword's thirst.
Flying Strike is almost ready.
No one can escape from me.
I never let my prey get away. Never.
Even if they try to run, all that awaits them is death.
I won't let even a single one escape.
No one can escape my grasp.
This will close the distance, then finish you off.
I'll show you a move with lightning speed!
They won't be able to keep up with this move.
With this, the enemy won't escape.
This will be useful for closing the distance.
There's no point in hiding.
I won't let you get away!
I'll pierce right through!
Crimson Slash is almost ready.
Crimson Slash is not ready.
I'll turn their blood into my strength.
Their lives will regenerate me.
I will fight. I won't flinch.
I’ll fight with my life, until the end.
Brother, please protect me.
No one can break my spirit.
I'm the one who will survive.
At this point, there is nothing that can stop my fight.
The one standing at the end will be me.
I will show you no mercy!
I'll slash you to pieces!
I cannot be killed by you.
There's still a chance to win!
No one kills the Seventh Moon.
I will walk through all of them.
Today won't be the end of the Seventh Moon.
My brother is ready to lend me his aid.
The shadows will be my armour.
Shadow Form is almost ready.
Shadow Form is not ready.
No matter how hard I'm pushed, I'll be the one to win in the end.
This move will turn the tide.
For generations, my clan has survived the jaws of death.
Don't think you can kill me that easily.
My brother will lead me to victory.
I’ll make you feel the wrath of the Seventh Moon.
Death will come for them.
I cannot die in a place like this.
Fear me, as I become a shadow.
Now, the real fight begins.
Know the true power of our family!
This is the power of the Seventh Moon!
Did you really think you could stop me?
Your fate has been sealed.
This is the power granted to the Seventh Moon.
This is not the end for the Seventh Moon!
Brother, give me your strength!
I bear the name of the Seventh Moon!
This is what happens to those who oppose the Seventh Moon.
Death awaits those who interfere with the completion of the ritual.
Anyone who opposes me will die.
Another one taken care of.
Did you think you could defeat me?
You picked the wrong opponent.
Your money means nothing.
Looks like you overestimated your own strength.
I don't forget what you did.
Thanks for finishing them off.
Their death was inevitable.
And now, we continue the slaughter.
I'll take you all down, one by one!
No one can escape the grasp of the Seventh Moon.
You cannot escape from me.
You're a fool to fight me.
Surrender, and I'll give you a quick death.
New York belongs to the Seventh Moon.
My strength has returned.
Bullets are useless against me.
I'll show you what happens when you piss off the Seventh Moon.
I merge with the shadows.
I'll disrupt their magic!
I’ll cripple their strength.
I'll take their blood for myself.
I should train my abilities.
I can buy something else.
I'll go to the store when I can.
I can get something of quality.
It's time to go shopping.
The right item can shape the battle.
I should spend the souls I have.
This belongs to the Seventh Moon.
This one belongs to the Seventh Moon.
The souls were never the goal in the first place.
The objective has been achieved.
Another objective achieved.
Another target conquered.
Come out and die with honour.
I won't let you escape next time.
Next time, I'll kill them.
You think you can kill me?
My brother's spirit protected me.
The enemy could be anywhere.
I may have overextended myself.
I will win, no matter situation.
There may be too many of them.
Witness the rise of the Seventh Moon.
I’ll bring ruin upon them.
I will end the battle myself.
Don't waste your bullets!
You think scrap like you can kill me?
Soon they will bow down to me.
I hope these guys aren't useless.
I will lead my team to victory!
Soon, the Seventh Moon will be running New York.
Anyone who stands in my way will surely die.
You weren't useless after all.
All of this is for my brother.
Follow the Ixian to battle!
Is that demon possessed by something?
That detective is pretty tough.
And now to make them suffer…
That machine is merciless.
I like the way Bebop fights.
That's an impressive machine.
I won't forget this, Dynamo.
Glad the sandman is on my side.
It seem's Haze's reputation is well earned.
Holliday left this behind…
I'll take every advantage.
She looks like she could be useful.
That caught them completely off guard.
Like a moth to the flame.
Seems Fairfax's lackey is useful after all.
She has a warrior's instinct.
I can feel your determination to win.
He's as deadly as they say…
I thought I knew what power looked like…
I guess I don't have to betray Wraith later…
Today my blade drinks Ixian blood.
…and he thought he was tough.
That was one big son of a bitch…
Kill this dumb detective!
You have much to learn, boy.
Ah, the arrogance of youth.
There's no shame in losing to me.
I won't lose to scrap metal.
I've cut Pinnochio's strings.
You aren't ready to fight me Bebop.
That machine fought well.
You made it too easy, Bebop!
The scrap golem never had a chance.
You're nothing compared to me, Calico…
I knew I could never trust you…
Crossing the Seventh Moon was a mistake, Calico…
Ha! This is "the most dangerous woman on the planet"?
This isn't some show, it's real life.
Go back and die in the circus.
The help are meant to be seen, not heard.
Know your place, Doorman.
I will burn The Baroness to the ground.
And he thought he was so clever…
I won't be your prey, Drifter.
He was strong, but not strong enough…
The professor could never stop me.
Hope he's a better teacher than a fighter.
A noble man, but a dead one.
You belong in the classroom, not on the battlefield.
You made a poor decision Dynamo.
Here comes the professor!
Look out for the black hole!
Be ready for the professor!
You meddle with things you could never understand…
You don't belong here, little girl.
She desecrates the memory of the dead.
I take no joy in killing an old man.
He had a warrior's heart.
He wasn't as frail as I thought he'd be.
I gave him the death he wanted!
I'm not afraid of the OSIC.
So that's what passes for an American assassin?
The Seventh Moon is untouchable.
The feds will have to learn their place.
All technique, no passion.
Stay out of my business Holliday.
When will the police learn…
The Seventh Moon is above the law.
I won't forgive this, Holliday!
I can't lose to a bartender.
You should’ve stayed retired.
I'm not an enemy you want, Infernus.
When this is over, I'll burn down his bar.
This is what happens when you fight your betters.
Thanks for dealing with Mendoza, saved me time.
For your insolence, I'm taking Spanish Harlem next.
That's the thing that stopped Mendoza? Taking over New York should be easy…
I don't see what people are so afraid of…
You don't belong among the living, Kelvin.
The dead belong in the ground.
His travels have come to an end.
Legends rarely live up to their reputation.
I'll take that arm as a trophy.
Oathkeeper could never protect you, Geist.
She should have died a long time ago.
American hubris will only get you so far.
His parents should have spanked him more.
Go back to the factory where you belong.
You are nothing to me, McGinnis.
You put too much faith in your creations.
How much more must I destroy?
That woman’s useless inventions...
Killed the annoying vampire.
You bring shame to your family.
I don't deal with servants.
You need to get better at your job.
Perhaps Nashala should work for me.
Protect the Djinn? Please, you couldn't protect yourself.
You're as useless as my brother's bodyguards were.
I'll turn the big one into a coat and the small one into a hat.
He thought his strength would save him.
She never should have left the library.
Your story ends here, Paige.
A pity I had to kill you.
It's a shame, she was tolerable.
Some people aren't cut out for war.
I don't play games, Paradox.
This is what happens when kids get cocky.
Compared to the Seventh Moon, the Paradox are like babies.
She's not as clever as she thought…
Is this the extent of your power, Paradox?
I'm disappointed, Paradox.
They were young and stupid...
No wonder your family disowned you.
They need to let go of the past.
Just give me the case, Pocket.
Your power is nothing before the Seventh Moon.
You're what people are afraid of?
He had delusions of grandeur.
I'll finish what your captors started.
I expected more from you, Seven.
You deny your nature, Shiv.
How long can he play at being a hero?
You run from your nature when you should run from me.
What's a knife compared to a sword?
That woman's a trainwreck.
Slaughtered the werewolf.
Where's your faith now, Father?
That's the best the Vatican has?
You never were going to beat me, Venator…
You're out of your depth, Venator.
Destroyed the abomination…
His existence offends me.
He had no business walking amongst the living.
Stand up all you want Victor, the result will be the same.
Why don't you wear shoes?
I could have used someone like her.
Truly a strange creature.
What the hell was that thing?
That goo creature offends me.
I don’t understand why anyone would team up with her.
She makes criminals look bad…
You never had a chance against me, Vyper.
You will never stop me, Warden.
